Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), robot learning, and embodied foundation models provide new opportunities to improve the autonomy and adaptability of such systems, but their transfer to space is constrained by scarce mission data, space-specific dynamics and sensing conditions, limited onboard resources, and stringent safety requirements. This article reviews artificial intelligence-enabled space robot operations (AI-SRO) from a capability-building perspective. We first summarize representative operational scenarios, autonomy trends, and space-specific constraints. We then establish a three-layer technical framework comprising capability foundations, capability formation, and capability deployment/evolution. Within this framework, we review simulation environments, datasets and benchmarks; task and environment understanding, state perception, decision-making and planning, and action execution; and onboard deployment, ground-to-space adaptation, continual learning, and capability transfer. Finally, we propose key research directions toward trustworthy simulation and data, open-world multimodal cognition, long-horizon safe decision-making, physically constrained policy learning, and space computing infrastructures.
summary_zh: 当前空间机器人越来越多地需要在有限人工干预下执行长时长、高接触、多阶段的操作任务。人工智能、机器人学习与具身基础模型的最新进展为提升这类系统的自主性与适应性提供了新机遇，但相关技术向空间场景迁移受限于任务数据稀缺、空间特有的动力学与传感条件、星载资源有限以及严苛的安全要求。本文从能力构建的视角综述人工智能赋能的空间机器人操作（AI-SRO）领域。首先总结了代表性操作场景、自主性发展趋势与空间特有约束，随后构建了包含能力基础、能力形成、能力部署与演化的三层技术框架。在该框架下，本文从仿真环境、数据集与基准测试集，任务与环境理解、状态感知、决策与规划、动作执行，星载部署、天地自适应、持续学习与能力迁移三个维度展开综述。最后指出了面向可信仿真与数据、开放世界多模态认知、长时域安全决策、物理约束下的策略学习以及空间计算基础设施的重点研究方向。

title: CoAdapt: An LLM-based Framework for Adaptive Collaborative Perception in IIoT Robotic Swarms
title_zh: CoAdapt：面向工业物联网机器人群的基于大语言模型的自适应协同感知框架
authors: Houssam Hajj Hassan, Antonia Maria Masucci, Lynda Zitoune, Salah-Eddine Elayoubi
abstract: Industrial IoT environments increasingly deploy autonomous mobile robots for tasks such as material handling, product assembly, or infrastructure inspection. In such deployments, collaborative perception enables robots to share LiDAR observations and collectively construct a richer model of their environment than an individual agent could produce alone. However, industrial environments are dynamic spaces where robot positions shift continuously, network bandwidth fluctuates, and the marginal contribution of robots to perception quality varies at runtime. Existing collaborative perception approaches are designed for static participation assumptions and cannot adapt to these dynamics without sacrificing either detection precision or communication efficiency. This paper presents CoAdapt, an adaptive collaborative perception framework for IIoT robotic swarms in which a Large Language Model (LLM) serves as a runtime fusion controller, jointly deciding which robots participate in the fusion process and which fusion algorithm to apply based on the current spatial configuration and network state. The LLM reasons over structured natural language descriptions of the scene derived from raw LiDAR point clouds, requiring no taskspecific training and generalizing to unseen swarm topologies. Evaluated on the OPV2V benchmark across 25 scenarios, our approach achieves a 38% reduction in communication cost while maintaining detection precision comparable to static baseline approaches.
summary_zh: 工业物联网（IIoT）环境中越来越多地部署自主移动机器人，用于物料搬运、产品装配、基础设施巡检等任务。这类部署场景下的协同感知可让机器人共享激光雷达观测信息，共同构建比单个智能体更丰富的环境模型。但工业环境是动态场景，机器人位置持续变化、网络带宽波动、不同机器人对感知质量的边际贡献随运行时动态改变。现有协同感知方法均基于静态参与假设设计，无法在不损失检测精度或通信效率的前提下适配这类动态变化。本文提出CoAdapt，面向工业物联网机器人群的自适应协同感知框架，该框架将大语言模型（LLM）作为运行时融合控制器，基于当前空间配置与网络状态，联合决策参与融合的机器人集合与所使用的融合算法。大语言模型基于从原始激光雷达点云生成的结构化自然语言场景描述进行推理，无需针对特定任务训练，可泛化到未见过的群拓扑结构。在OPV2V基准测试集的25个场景下评估，所提方法的通信成本降低38%，同时可保持与静态基线方法相当的检测精度。

title: Rethinking Visual Embodiment Dependence in Visuomotor Policies
title_zh: 重新审视视觉运动策略中的视觉具身依赖特性
authors: Hongjie Fang, Yuxuan Lu, Chenxi Wang, Haoxiang Qin, Shirun Tang 等 (11 人)
abstract: Visuomotor policies observe both the task scene and the acting embodiment, allowing embodiment-specific visual cues to influence action prediction. We study this phenomenon as visual embodiment dependence (VED) and show, through cue-conflict interventions across representative policies, that visible robot configuration can become a shortcut to task progress. Rather than eliminating VED, we argue that it should be structured around embodiment information that supports control and generalization. We realize this through embodiment canonicalization in 3D point clouds, replacing the original embodiment with a canonical end-effector representation (CER) that preserves control-relevant geometry while abstracting embodiment-specific morphology. Its editable form further enables configuration-decorrelation augmentation for unfamiliar robot configurations. Experiments show that embodiment canonicalization substantially improves human-to-robot policy transfer without robot demonstrations, while simply removing the embodiment is insufficient without preserving control-relevant geometry. We further find that CER itself can become a configuration shortcut when robot configuration becomes decoupled from task progress; configuration-decorrelation augmentation mitigates this failure mode and restores robust recovery without sacrificing performance on seen configurations. Together, these results show that robust visuomotor learning benefits from structuring, rather than removing, visual embodiment information. Project website:this https URL
summary_zh: 视觉运动策略同时观测任务场景与执行动作的具身本体，允许具身相关的视觉线索影响动作预测。本文将该现象定义为视觉具身依赖（VED），通过在代表性策略上开展线索冲突干预实验发现，可见的机器人配置可能成为任务进度的捷径特征。本文认为不应消除视觉具身依赖，而应基于支撑控制与泛化的具身信息对其进行结构化设计。本文通过3D点云中的具身规范化实现该目标，用规范末端执行器表征（CER）替换原始具身，在保留控制相关几何特征的同时抽象掉具身特定的形态学特征。该表征的可编辑特性进一步支持针对未知机器人配置的配置解相关增强。实验表明，具身规范化可在无需机器人演示的前提下大幅提升人-机器人策略迁移性能，而单纯移除具身信息若不保留控制相关几何特征则无法实现该效果。本文进一步发现，当机器人配置与任务进度解耦时，规范末端执行器表征本身也可能成为配置捷径，而配置解相关增强可缓解该失效模式，在不降低已知配置下性能的前提下恢复鲁棒性。上述结果表明，鲁棒的视觉运动学习需要对视觉具身信息进行结构化设计，而非直接移除。项目网站见对应链接。

title: Motion planning in high dimensional spaces hybridizing RRT and HAR via position-direction decoupling
title_zh: 基于位置-方向解耦融合快速探索随机树与Hit-and-Run（游走采样法，HAR）的高维空间运动规划方法
authors: Frederic Cazals, Nelson Feyeux
abstract: The exploration of high-dimensional spaces remains a challenging problem, in particular in the presence of narrow passages and small clearances. We propose novel sampling-based path-planning methods for high-dimensional spaces combining Rapidly-exploring Random Trees (RRT) and Hit-and-Run (HAR) random walks by decoupling the point being extended from the direction of extension. We also show that RRT and HAR appear as special cases of a generic algorithm coupling the biases used for the point and direction extension, respectively. We further study a sparse-move strategy in which only a fraction p_r of the robots is moved at each step, helping both RRT and the proposed HAR algorithms handle cluttered instances. Tests are presented for two families of models: classical piano mover problems in 3D, and complex molecular systems involving tens of rigid domains moving relatively to one another -- the latter viewed as independent robots exploring the motion space SE(3)N . Within seconds on a standard laptop, our algorithms solve instances with up to 64 robots and 384 degrees of freedom. We conclude by suggesting one of our methods, HARF, as the method of choice for complex multi-robot planning problems, being up to two orders of magnitude faster than the classical RRT moving all robots at each step--when it succeeds at all, and still up to 2.4 fold faster on most instances when both use their best p_r.
summary_zh: 高维空间探索始终是极具挑战性的问题，在存在窄通道与小间隙的场景下难度尤为突出。本文提出一类面向高维空间的新型基于采样的路径规划方法，通过将待扩展点与扩展方向解耦，融合快速探索随机树（RRT）与Hit-and-Run（游走采样法，HAR）随机游走的优势。本文同时证明，RRT与HAR可作为通用算法的特例，分别对应点扩展与方向扩展的偏置耦合机制。本文进一步研究了稀疏移动策略，每步仅移动占比为p_r的部分机器人，可同时提升RRT与所提HAR算法处理密集场景的性能。本文在两类模型上开展测试：经典3D钢琴搬运工问题，以及包含数十个相对运动刚性域的复杂分子系统——后者可视为独立机器人在运动空间SE(3)^N中探索。在普通笔记本电脑上，所提算法可在数秒内求解最多包含64个机器人、384个自由度的规划实例。最终本文推荐所提的HARF方法作为复杂多机器人规划问题的首选方案，相比每步移动所有机器人的经典RRT方法，在可求解的实例上速度最高提升两个数量级，在两者均采用最优p_r参数的多数实例上速度仍可最高提升2.4倍。

title: Optimal Excitation Trajectories for System Identification of Underwater Vehicles
title_zh: 面向水下机器人系统辨识的最优激励轨迹
authors: Fotis Panetsos, Kostas J. Kyriakopoulos
abstract: In this work, we propose a structured methodology for the system identification of underwater vehicles through the design of optimal excitation trajectories. To this end, the trajectories are parameterized using Bezier curves, which ensure smooth and differentiable motion profiles while facilitating the enforcement of constraints through appropriate manipulation of the control points. An optimization problem is formulated to determine a dynamically feasible excitation trajectory that respects safety limits and maximizes the quality of the collected data, thereby enabling reliable estimation of the vehicle's dynamic parameters using least squares. The proposed methodology is experimentally validated in a laboratory water tank, where the dynamic parameters, identified from the optimized trajectory, are evaluated by predicting the vehicle's velocity through forward simulation on previously unseen trajectories.
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一套结构化方法，通过设计最优激励轨迹实现水下机器人的系统辨识。该方法采用贝塞尔（Bezier）曲线对轨迹进行参数化，既保证运动轮廓平滑可微，又可通过合理调整控制点便捷地施加各类约束。研究构建了优化问题，用于确定满足安全限制、可最大化采集数据质量的动力学可行激励轨迹，从而支持通过最小二乘法可靠估计水下机器人的动力学参数。所提出的方法在实验室水箱环境中完成了实验验证：通过优化轨迹辨识得到的动力学参数，被用于在从未见过的轨迹上开展正向仿真，预测水下机器人的运动速度，验证了辨识结果的有效性。

title: The Latent That Never Was: A Forensic Re-run of the CVAE Ablation in Action Chunking Transformer
title_zh: 从未存在的潜变量：动作分块Transformer（Action Chunking Transformer, ACT）中条件变分自编码器（Conditional Variational Autoencoder, CVAE）消融实验的溯源复现
authors: Bo Kang
abstract: Action Chunking Transformers (ACT) are widely used to learn robot manipulation from demonstrations. Their conditional variational autoencoder includes an encoder meant to capture differences between demonstrations during training. The original ACT paper reported that encoder removal dropped the mean success rate from 35% to 2% on two simulated tasks with human demonstrations. We re-ran this ablation in the original code and checked whether the findings depend on the implementation or training data. The published drop does not reappear in our tests, although smaller gains or losses in success rate remain uncertain. To investigate the discrepancy, we varied training length and how checkpoints are selected for evaluation. Both can reverse which policy scores higher, but the published drop's cause remains unknown. Success rates alone leave open whether the encoder provides information that helps the policy reconstruct demonstrated actions. On the tested ACT benchmark, the sampled latent provides little reconstruction benefit at every tested nonzero weight of the penalty on latent information. At inference, ACT leaves this latent unused and sets it to zero. Skipping the encoder increases training throughput in both implementations we timed. We release code, evaluation tools and results so others can repeat the comparisons and test the encoder on other tasks.
summary_zh: 动作分块Transformer（ACT）被广泛用于从演示数据中学习机器人操作技能，其内置的条件变分自编码器包含一个编码器，设计目标是在训练过程中捕捉不同演示样本之间的差异。ACT原始论文报告称，在两项基于人类演示的模拟任务中，移除该编码器会将平均成功率从35%降至2%。本研究基于原始代码重新运行了该消融实验，验证上述结论是否依赖于具体实现方式或训练数据。测试中并未复现论文报告的大幅性能下降现象，仅观测到成功率存在小幅波动，其影响仍无法确定。为解释该差异，研究调整了训练时长和评估用检查点的选择方式，发现这两个因素都可能反转不同策略的性能高低，但仍无法解释原始论文报告的性能骤降的成因。仅靠成功率指标无法判断编码器是否为策略提供了有助于重构演示动作的有效信息。在测试的ACT基准任务中，对于所有非零的潜变量信息惩罚权重，采样得到的潜变量几乎都无法为动作重构带来增益。在推理阶段，ACT实际上并未使用该潜变量，而是直接将其置零。在本研究测试的两种实现方案中，移除编码器都能提升训练吞吐量。本研究公开了相关代码、评估工具和实验结果，供其他研究者复现对比并在更多任务上测试该编码器的作用。

title: CorrRisk-WM: Corridor-Conditioned Risk World Modeling for Safety-Critical Trajectory Planning
title_zh: CorrRisk-WM：面向安全关键轨迹规划的走廊条件风险世界建模
authors: Tingyu Guo, Reza Langari
abstract: Safe local planning requires forecasting surrounding-agent motion and evaluating candidate-specific risks, since identical agent motion can pose different risks to different ego trajectories. We present CorrRisk-WM, a planning-oriented partial world model coupling environment evolution with supervised intrusion and near-miss prediction over bounded candidate-trajectory corridors. A latent environment model recursively predicts agent states and updates agent-agent and agent-map interactions. Each candidate queries the evolving environment through footprint- aware geometry and learned agent-corridor representations. A lightweight recurrent risk module uses temporal context to estimate per-slice hazards; survival aggregation yields first-entry and horizon-level event probabilities. On 29,176 scenarios from 100 Waymo validation shards, CorrRisk-WM achieves intrusion average precision (AP) of 0.8567 and 1-m near-miss first-entry AP of 0.8671. In baseline comparisons, it attains the highest near-miss AP at all three distance thresholds and the lowest observed open-loop collision rate (4.88%), with route progress of 15.35 m. Across three seeds, removing dynamic environment modeling or candidate-conditioned geometric interaction reduces mean intrusion AP from 0.8590 to 0.7624 and 0.7252, respectively. These results support coupling environment evolution with candidate-conditioned geometric reasoning for risk prediction and safety-oriented candidate selection.
summary_zh: 安全的局部规划需要预测周边智能体的运动，同时评估不同候选轨迹对应的专属风险，因为相同的周边智能体运动对不同的自车轨迹可能造成截然不同的风险。本文提出CorrRisk-WM（走廊条件风险世界模型），这是一个面向规划任务的部分世界模型，将环境演化预测与针对有界候选轨迹走廊的侵入、险情预测任务相结合。该模型通过潜环境模型递归预测智能体状态，更新智能体之间、智能体与地图之间的交互关系。每个候选轨迹通过考虑占用区域的几何特征和学习得到的智能体-走廊表征，查询动态演化的环境状态。轻量级循环风险模块利用时序上下文估计每个时间切片的危险程度，通过生存聚合得到首次侵入事件和规划时域级别的事件概率。在Waymo验证集的100个分片共29176个场景中，CorrRisk-WM的侵入平均精度（AP）达到0.8567，1米级险情首次侵入平均精度达到0.8671。与基线方法的对比结果显示，该模型在三个距离阈值下均取得最高的险情平均精度，同时观测到的开环碰撞率最低（4.88%），可实现15.35米的路径推进距离。在三组不同随机种子的测试中，移除动态环境建模或移除候选条件几何交互模块，会将平均侵入平均精度从0.8590分别降至0.7624和0.7252。上述结果证明，将环境演化预测与候选条件几何推理相结合，可有效支撑风险预测和面向安全的候选轨迹筛选。

title: The Robot Data Factory
title_zh: 机器人数据工厂
authors: Sami Haddadin, Ivan Laptev, Ian Reid, Dezhen Song, Cesare Stefanini 等 (21 人)
abstract: Physical AI requires more than increasingly large robot datasets: intelligent robots acquire knowledge through continuous interaction with the physical world. We argue that the defining scientific resource of Physical AI is therefore not raw robot data alone, but robot experience - physically grounded interaction whose observations, actions, embodiment, context, and outcomes preserve the perception-action-consequence loop. We introduce the Robot Data Factory (RDF), a mission-driven infrastructure and methodology for continuously generating, validating, benchmarking, and reusing such experience. RDF organizes heterogeneous robots and environment-specific training grounds through reproducible missions, skill curricula, synchronized multimodal sensing, external ground truth, an agentic robot network, data pipelines, and living benchmarks. Rather than treating datasets as static end products, RDF implements a closed Deploy-Measure-Learn-Repeat cycle in which validated physical experience supports world models, vision-language-action models, embodied policies, digital twins, and subsequent robot deployment. We further formalize robot experience and its quality, introduce a mission-task-skill-episode-dataset-benchmark-capability hierarchy, and derive quantitative scaling laws and an algorithmic synthesis procedure connecting robot fleet size, sensor rates, storage, learning representations, tokenization, training compute, inference, and latency to Embodied-AI cluster requirements. The framework is instantiated in three complementary physical training grounds for domestic, environmental, and energy applications. RDF thus reframes robot data generation as a continuous scientific production process and provides a pathway toward reproducible, scalable, and eventually federated infrastructure for Physical AI.
summary_zh: 物理人工智能（Physical AI）的发展不能仅依赖规模不断扩大的机器人数据集：智能机器人需要通过与物理世界的持续交互获取知识。本研究认为，物理人工智能的核心科学资源并非原始机器人数据，而是机器人经验——这类具备物理基础的交互数据完整保留了感知-动作-结果闭环，包含观测、动作、具身形态、上下文和结果信息。本文提出机器人数据工厂（Robot Data Factory, RDF），这是一套以任务为驱动的基础设施与方法体系，用于持续生成、验证、基准测试和复用上述机器人经验。RDF通过可复现的任务、技能课程、同步多模态传感、外部真值、智能体机器人网络、数据流水线和动态基准体系，对异构机器人和面向特定环境的训练场地进行统一组织。RDF没有将数据集视为静态最终产物，而是实现了“部署-测量-学习-重复”的闭环流程，经过验证的物理经验可支撑世界模型、视觉-语言-动作模型、具身策略、数字孪生开发以及后续的机器人部署。本研究进一步对机器人经验及其质量进行了形式化定义，提出了“任务-技能-片段-数据集-基准-能力”的层级架构，推导了定量缩放定律和算法合成流程，建立了机器人集群规模、传感器采样率、存储资源、学习表征、分词策略、训练算力、推理性能、时延与具身人工智能（Embodied AI）集群需求之间的关联。该框架已在面向家庭、环境监测和能源场景的三类互补物理训练场地中落地实现。RDF将机器人数据生成重新定义为持续的科学生产流程，为物理人工智能提供了可复现、可扩展、最终可实现联邦化的基础设施路径。

title: World Models for Embodied Intelligence: From Plausible to Controllable to Actionable
title_zh: IL-ACT：面向30吨级挖掘机的带自适应笛卡尔跟踪控制的模仿学习
authors: Nanjie Yao, Hao Wang, Chong Cheng, Zhikang Chen, Wenzhe Li 等 (13 人)
abstract: World models connect perception and decision-making in embodied intelligence by maintaining hidden state, anticipating consequences, comparing interventions, and adapting when execution departs from expectations. Although progress is often measured by visual fidelity, their value lies in improving behavior. Before reaching for a cup, a person anticipates its weight and resistance to grasping, shaping the hand before contact. Such anticipation is coarse and rarely pictorial, yet it guides action. This raises a central question: which predictive capabilities improve behavior? Existing surveys, organized by architecture, output modality, or application domain, leave this question implicit. We introduce three progressively stronger capability levels: Plausible models preserve task-relevant temporal, geometric, or physical structure; Controllable models additionally predict how interventions alter that structure; and Actionable models translate predictions into measurable gains in planning, action, learning, evaluation, verification, recovery, or data selection. We complement this hierarchy with a 3 x 4 matrix crossing geometry, physics, and action grounding with improvement loops centered on data, rewards, policies, and the model itself. Using this framework, we survey manipulation, navigation, locomotion, autonomous driving, and general embodied learning, tracing technical progressions, clarifying capability requirements, and examining datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols. We identify challenges in long-horizon consistency, uncertainty calibration, causal intervention testing, latency, verification and recovery, and cross-embodiment transfer. This perspective shifts evaluation from visual plausibility toward whether predictions capture task-relevant state, reflect intervention effects, and improve the closed-loop behavior of embodied agents.
summary_zh: 自主挖掘机控制面临运动学耦合、执行器滞后和不确定性等多重挑战。本文提出IL-ACT（带自适应笛卡尔跟踪的模仿学习框架），这是一套面向30吨级挖掘机的新型运动控制框架。该框架首先采用基于操作员演示预训练的锚定14输入模仿策略生成名义关节速率，随后通过自适应笛卡尔反馈和门控增益/偏置估计对控制指令进行校正，最终由停车距离限制器约束关节参考量的生成。基于Simscape仿真平台的评估覆盖100个连续目标点，以及螺旋、8字形、圆角光栅三类跟踪任务，还包含在三种训练随机种子、两种初始化方式、不同速度、不同液压响应和传感条件下的88组额外测试。与Teacher+ACT基线方法相比，IL-ACT在两种液压响应条件下均能完成所有目标任务，且耗时更短、终端误差更低。在24组8字形和圆角光栅任务的不同种子对比中，采用遥测初始化的IL-ACT的均方根误差（RMSE）全面低于基线方法，额外负载下螺旋任务的平均均方根误差降低约29%，螺旋任务的原始均方根误差也优于纯模仿学习方法和PID控制器。在相同传感器噪声条件下，遥测初始化的IL-ACT的平均均方根误差比Teacher+ACT低27.67%；与固定估计器的情况相比，启用估计功能可将平均均方根误差降低22.44%。预训练权重的影响呈现混合特性，原始教师对比组在螺旋任务中存在均方根误差与最大误差的权衡关系。理论分析证明自适应状态和笛卡尔反馈均有界，参考量的可接受性以限制器的可行性为前提。

title: IL-ACT: Imitation Learning with Adaptive Cartesian Tracking Control for a 30-ton Excavator
authors: Mehdi Heydari Shahna, Seihun Kim, Soyi Jung, Soohyun Park, Jouni Mattila 等 (6 人)
abstract: Autonomous excavator control is challenged by coupled kinematics, actuation lag, and uncertainty. We propose imitation learning and adaptive Cartesian tracking (IL-ACT), a novel motion control framework for a 30-ton-class excavator. An anchored, 14-input imitation policy pretrained on operator demonstrations generates nominal joint rates; adaptive Cartesian feedback and gated gain/bias estimation correct these commands before a stopping-distance governor constrains joint-reference generation. Simscape evaluation covers 100 sequential goals and spiral, figure-eight, and rounded-raster tracking, including 88 additional runs across three training seeds, two initializations, and speeds, under hydraulic response and sensing conditions. Compared with Teacher+ACT, IL-ACT completes all goals with shorter duration and lower terminal errors under both response conditions. Telemetry-initialized IL-ACT lowers RMSE in all 24 figure-eight and rounded-raster seed comparisons and lowers additional-load spiral mean RMSE by approximately 29%. Original spiral RMSE also improves over IL-only and PID. Under a shared sensor-noise realization, telemetry-initialized IL-ACT achieves 27.67% lower mean RMSE than Teacher+ACT; enabling estimation reduces mean RMSE by $22.44\%$ relative to the frozen estimator. Pretrained-weight effects remain mixed, and the original teacher comparison exhibits a spiral RMSE--maximum-error tradeoff. Analysis establishes bounded adaptive states and Cartesian feedback, with reference admissibility conditional on governor feasibility.

title: Weave: Learning Whole-Body Dexterous Loco-Manipulation from Human-Object Interactions
title_zh: Weave：从人物交互中学习全身灵巧移动操作
authors: Liu Cao, Xingze Wu, Jingzhi Cui, Botian Xu, Mingzhi Pei 等 (7 人)
abstract: Learning humanoid-object interaction requires coordinating whole-body balance, locomotion, and dexterous hand contact to control both robot and object motion. Human demonstrations provide examples of coordinated interaction, but transferring these behaviors to humanoid robots requires learning how to establish and maintain effective contacts under different embodiments and dynamics. We present Weave, a unified framework for learning whole-body dexterous humanoid-object interaction from captured human demonstrations. Weave first converts captured human-object interactions into executable robot-object references through contact-aware retargeting and approach-motion completion. At its core is a contact- and geometry-aware policy that jointly commands 29 body joints and 12 actuated finger joints across multiple objects and interaction sequences. Evaluation across nine objects yields a 92.5% success rate on trained interactions and, without any additional training, 65.0% on sequences never seen during training. We additionally release ~9,000 physically executed rollouts spanning ~23 hours, providing robot-object trajectories with contact annotations for downstream interaction-policy learning and physically consistent HOI motion generation. Project website:this https URL
summary_zh: 学习人形机器人与物体的交互需要协调全身平衡、移动能力和灵巧手部接触，同时控制机器人自身和交互对象的运动。人类演示提供了协调交互的示例，但将这类行为迁移到人形机器人平台，需要学习如何在不同具身形态和动力学条件下建立并维持有效接触。本文提出Weave，这是一套从采集到的人类演示数据中学习全身灵巧人形机器人-物体交互的统一框架。Weave首先通过接触感知重定向和接近运动补全，将采集到的人类-物体交互数据转换为可执行的机器人-物体参考轨迹。其核心是一个具备接触感知和几何感知的策略，可跨多个对象和交互序列同时控制29个身体关节和12个驱动手指关节。在9个不同对象上开展的评估显示，该框架在训练过的交互任务上成功率达92.5%，在未经过额外训练的未见过的交互序列上成功率达65.0%。本研究还公开了约9000次物理执行的交互轨迹，总时长约23小时，提供带接触标注的机器人-物体轨迹，可用于下游交互策略学习和物理一致的人-物交互（HOI）运动生成。项目主页见对应链接。

title: WholeBodyWAM: Generalizing Pre-trained World-Action Priors to Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via WBC-Grounded Coordination
title_zh: WholeBodyWAM：基于全身控制（WBC）接地协调的预训练世界动作先验向人形机器人移动操作的泛化
authors: Zhuo Li, Yiming Yao, Jim Tan, Mengjie Jing, Zhipeng Dong 等 (6 人)
abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising approach to general-purpose robot manipulation by jointly modeling visual dynamics and actions. However, most WAM studies focus on tabletop or arm-centric manipulation, while humanoid loco-manipulation remains less explored. To address this gap, we introduce WholeBodyWAM, which jointly predicts future visual dynamics, manipulation actions, and whole-body control intents for generalizable humanoid loco-manipulation. It preserves pre-trained world-action priors while grounding heterogeneous whole-body controller (WBC) semantics and coordinating whole-body behavior. Extensive experiments show that WholeBodyWAM achieves an overall simulation task success rate of 91.9%, with a 0.23 improvement in real-world out-of-distribution task progress and a 70% reduction in success-rate variance across WBCs relative to the respective baselines. These results suggest a path toward scalable humanoid whole-body intelligence by extending pre-trained world-action priors through structured WBC grounding and coordination, rather than relearning whole-body behavior from scratch. Project page:this https URL.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（World Action Models, WAMs）通过联合建模视觉动力学和动作，为通用机器人操作提供了极具前景的技术路径。但现有多数世界动作模型研究聚焦于桌面操作或单臂操作场景，针对人形机器人移动操作的探索仍较为不足。为填补这一空白，本文提出WholeBodyWAM，该模型可同时预测未来视觉动力学、操作动作和全身控制意图，实现可泛化的人形机器人移动操作。该框架在保留预训练世界动作先验的同时，对异构全身控制器（Whole-Body Controller, WBC）的语义进行接地，协调全身行为。大量实验结果显示，WholeBodyWAM在仿真任务中的整体成功率达91.9%，与对应基线相比，真实世界分布外任务的推进性能提升0.23，跨不同全身控制器的成功率方差降低70%。上述结果表明，无需从零开始重新学习全身行为，通过结构化的全身控制接地与协调扩展预训练世界动作先验，是实现可扩展人形机器人全身智能的可行路径。项目主页见对应链接。

title: SAVLA: Symmetry-Aware Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: SAVLA：面向机器人操作的对称性感知视觉-语言-动作模型
authors: Junle Li, Weixian Waylon Li, Fuxiang Wu, Fusheng Hao, Fengxiang He
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have become the dominant paradigm for language-conditioned robot manipulation. However, although images and language instructions inherently encode geometric information, VLAs acquire their spatial competence purely from demonstrations. As a result, they are reliable only within the range of scene poses that the demonstrations cover. We propose SAVLA, an end-to-end symmetry-aware VLA model for robust and data-efficient policy learning. Our approach keeps the pretrained vision-language backbone entirely frozen while combining it with an equivariant flow-matching action head and a learned canonicalizer. The head decomposes its state, action, and conditioning inputs into invariant and equivariant channels, and preserves this typing throughout all of its layers. The canonicalizer transforms oblique-view images into a canonical frame and rotates the geometric conditions consistently. We evaluate our model on LIBERO. Compared with the GR00T N1.5 baseline, SAVLA improves the success rate averaged over all four LIBERO suites by 5.1 points and increases the mean success rate under rotation on LIBERO-Goal from 41.5% to 90.4%.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型已成为语言条件机器人操作的主流范式。但尽管图像和语言指令本身天然包含几何信息，视觉-语言-动作模型的空间能力完全从演示数据中习得，因此仅能在演示覆盖的场景位姿范围内可靠工作。本文提出SAVLA（对称性感知视觉-语言-动作模型），这是一个端到端的具备对称性感知能力的视觉-语言-动作模型，可实现鲁棒且数据高效的策略学习。该方法完全冻结预训练的视觉-语言主干网络，将其与等变流匹配动作头和学习得到的规范化器相结合。动作头将状态、动作和条件输入分解为不变通道和等变通道，并在所有网络层中保留该属性。规范化器将斜视角图像转换为规范帧，同时对几何条件进行一致旋转。在LIBERO基准数据集上开展的评估显示，与GR00T N1.5基线模型相比，SAVLA在全部四个LIBERO套件上的平均成功率提升5.1个百分点，在LIBERO-Goal数据集上旋转场景下的平均成功率从41.5%提升至90.4%。

title: Learning to Optimize UAV Path Planning for Data Sensing in Wireless Sensor Networks
title_zh: 面向无线传感器网络数据感知的无人机路径规划优化学习方法
authors: Sijie Ma, Zeyuan Ma, Weijia Cao, Yue-Jiao Gong, Lingling Ma 等 (7 人)
abstract: UAVs have emerged as highly flexible platforms for data sensing in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs). Path planning for UAVs in such tasks plays a key role to assure remote sensing effectiveness and friendly energy consumption. However, existing approaches show two key limitations: i) they are primarily hand-crafted with certain design biases that harm adaptation on unseen tasks. ii) they predominantly assume idealized spatial complexities of actual environments through simplified simulation, causing them to underperform during real-world deployment. In this paper, we propose a novel learning-assisted planning framework, termed Landscape-Aware Meta Differential Evolution (LAMDE), to tackle the mentioned limitations. The major contributions come from the following aspects. We first re-formulate such UAV path planning problem to embrace challenging constraints. To efficiently navigate this highly constrained space, we propose a bi-level learning to optimize approach, where the meta-level is a trainable algorithm configuration policy that meta-learns an adaptable planning strategy for low-level planning algorithm. To address the potential training data scarcity and distribution shift in real-world environments, we introduce a landscape-aware automatic augmentation scheme that enriches training data. At the low-level, a Differential Evolution algorithm is deployed for solving the path planning tasks. To enhance the solving flexibility, we further design a variable-length encoding strategy that dynamically prunes redundant hover points and optimizes continuous flight parameters concurrently within a unified search space. Based on all proposed designs, we meta-train LAMDE and compare it with representative baselines. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that LAMDE achieves state-of-the-art performance on the tested complex UAV path planning tasks in WSN data collection scenarios.
summary_zh: 无人机已成为无线传感器网络（Wireless Sensor Networks, WSN）中极具灵活性的数据感知平台，该类任务中的无人机路径规划是保障遥感有效性和能耗友好性的核心环节。但现有方法存在两大局限：1）大多基于人工规则设计，存在固有设计偏差，在未见过的任务场景中适配性差；2）大多通过简化仿真假设真实环境的空间复杂度，导致实际部署时性能下降。本文提出一种新型学习辅助规划框架，命名为景观感知元差分进化（Landscape-Aware Meta Differential Evolution, LAMDE），用于解决上述问题。本文的主要贡献如下：首先对该类无人机路径规划问题进行重新形式化，纳入各类复杂约束。为高效探索高约束空间，本文提出双层学习优化方法，其中元层级为可训练的算法配置策略，通过元学习为底层规划算法习得自适应规划策略。为解决真实环境中潜在的训练数据稀缺和分布偏移问题，本文提出景观感知自动增广方案，用于丰富训练数据。底层部署差分进化算法求解路径规划任务，为提升求解灵活性，进一步设计可变长度编码策略，可在统一搜索空间内动态剪枝冗余悬停点，同时优化连续飞行参数。基于上述设计对LAMDE开展元训练，并与代表性基线方法进行对比，大量实验证明，在无线传感器网络数据采集场景的复杂无人机路径规划任务中，LAMDE取得了当前最优性能。

title: ProxiDex: Learning Dynamics-Guided Proximity Policy for Dexterous Manipulation
title_zh: ProxiDex：面向灵巧操作的动力学引导近邻策略学习
authors: Yushan Bai, Boyu Zheng, Zhiyang Mao, Hongzheng Sun, Yuchuang Tong 等 (7 人)
abstract: Multi-finger dexterous manipulation relies on stable hand-object interactions, yet these interactions are partially observable in practice. Visual observations are often occluded by the hand, tactile sensors introduce hardware-specific modalities and calibration burdens, and existing policies rarely model how these cues evolve under actions, making them brittle under contact uncertainty. To address these, we present ProxiDex, a dynamics-guided proximity policy framework that treats hand-object proximity as an interaction state for dexterous manipulation. ProxiDex reconstructs interaction point clouds and converts geometric distances into proximity cues, forming a hardware-agnostic contact representation that provides immersive feedback during VR teleoperation. Built on this representation, ProxiDex learns action-conditioned proximity dynamics with a coupled forward-inverse design: future observation latents are predicted from actions, while proximity variations are decoded from latent changes. Leveraging these dynamics, ProxiDex adaptively reweights proximity tokens across manipulation phases and uses dynamics-consistency supervision to guide policy inference, stabilizing action generation under unreliable visual feedback. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate improved success rates and robustness over representative baselines across standard, unseen objects, and perturbation scenarios. Additional visualizations are available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 多指灵巧操作依赖稳定的手-物交互，但实际场景中这类交互存在部分可观测问题：视觉观测常被手部遮挡，触觉传感器会引入硬件专属模态并带来校准负担，现有策略很少对动作下交互线索的演化规律建模，导致其在接触不确定性下鲁棒性较差。为解决上述问题，本文提出ProxiDex——一种动力学引导的近邻策略框架，将手-物近邻关系作为灵巧操作的交互状态。ProxiDex重建交互点云，将几何距离转换为近邻线索，生成与硬件无关的接触表征，可在VR遥操作过程中提供沉浸式反馈。基于该表征，ProxiDex采用前向-反向耦合设计学习动作条件近邻动力学：从动作预测未来观测隐变量，再从隐变量变化解码近邻变化。利用该动力学模型，ProxiDex可在不同操作阶段自适应调整近邻令牌的权重，采用动力学一致性监督引导策略推理，在视觉反馈不可靠的场景下稳定动作生成过程。仿真与真实世界实验表明，在标准场景、未知物体场景和扰动场景下，该方法的成功率与鲁棒性均优于代表性基线方法。更多可视化内容可访问对应链接。

title: Beyond Gestures: Estimating Full Hand Pose and Contact Forces from Wrist-Worn Pressure Sensor Array
title_zh: 超越手势：基于腕部佩戴压力传感器阵列的全手姿态与接触力估计
authors: Svetoslav Kolev, Lingni Ma, Michael Goesele, Renzo De Nardi, Jakob Engel 等 (6 人)
abstract: Capturing hand motion and interaction forces is critical for interactive computing, VR, and high-fidelity tactile demonstrations for robot learning. We introduce a wrist-worn pressure-sensing wristband that recovers continuous full-hand pose and distributed contact force on a single wearable. The system consists of flexible capacitive sensor arrays around the wrist, which require no electrical skin contact, and a recurrent network that maps the resulting pressure signal to hand state. Our key insight is that muscle contraction and tendon displacement produce pressure patterns, which correlate strongly with hand pose and interaction force. To validate this, we collect synchronized recordings of wrist pressure, optical motion-capture hand pose, and tactile-glove interaction force, covering isolated finger motion, fingertip-force stress tests, and natural hand-object manipulation. On isolated single-user motion the wristband attains $4.6^\circ$ mean finger-joint MAE, and across four users manipulating everyday objects it estimates per-finger contact force at $R^2=0.57$, which an external pose signal brings up to $0.75$. We see the wristband as one node in a constellation of everyday wearables -- e.g. paired with an egocentric camera -- adding the contact force that vision cannot observe and taking over when the hand is occluded.
summary_zh: 手部运动与交互力捕获对人机交互计算、VR以及机器人学习的高保真触觉演示至关重要。本文提出一款腕戴式压力传感手环，仅通过单台可穿戴设备即可还原连续的全手姿态与分布式接触力。该系统由环绕腕部的柔性电容传感器阵列（无需与皮肤电接触）和循环网络组成，可将采集到的压力信号映射为手部状态。核心设计思路为：肌肉收缩与肌腱位移产生的压力模式与手部姿态、交互力存在强相关性。为验证该结论，本文采集了腕部压力、光学动捕手部姿态、触觉手套交互力的同步数据集，覆盖单指独立运动、指尖力应力测试、自然手物交互操作三类场景。在单用户独立运动测试中，该手环的手指关节平均绝对误差（MAE）达4.6°；在4名用户操作日常物体的测试中，单指接触力估计的决定系数R²达0.57，接入外部姿态信号后可提升至0.75。该手环可作为日常可穿戴设备生态中的一个节点（例如搭配第一视角相机使用），补充视觉无法观测的接触力信息，在手部被遮挡时继续完成感知任务。

title: UniDex-ViTac: Learning Unified Visuo-Tactile Dexterous Manipulation Policy from Human Video Data
title_zh: UniDex-ViTac：从人类视频数据学习统一视觉触觉灵巧操作策略
authors: Hyesung Lee, Si-Hwan Heo, Sungwook Yang
abstract: Human videos provide demonstrations of dexterous manipulation but lack robot-executable actions and tactile measurements. We present UniDex-ViTac, a framework that uses human-video-guided simulation to generate robot demonstrations paired with fingertip contact observations for training a deployable visuo-tactile policy. Object-specific residual reinforcement learning specialists adapt annotated human-object interaction references to a robotic arm-hand system. Their successful rollouts pair final robot action targets with robot-side fingertip contact observations. From 50 human demonstrations across ten objects, we collect 10,000 simulated trajectories to train a single Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) based generalist. The policy combines point clouds, proprioception, and four binary contact signals encoded through fingertip labels and a separate token, without requiring human references or privileged object identity and pose at deployment. The contact-augmented configuration achieves 68.3% macro-average success in simulation, compared with 55.5% for the point-cloud-only baseline. Without real-robot demonstrations or policy fine-tuning, it succeeds in 73/110 physical trials (66.4%) across six seen and five unseen objects, compared with 60/110 (54.5%) for the baseline, an increase of 11.8 percentage points. These results support the feasibility of learning a unified visuo-tactile dexterous manipulation policy from video-guided simulated interactions. Project page:this https URL
summary_zh: 人类视频可提供灵巧操作演示，但缺少机器人可执行的动作信息与触觉测量数据。本文提出UniDex-ViTac框架，采用人类视频引导仿真生成配对的机器人演示数据与指尖接触观测结果，用于训练可部署的视觉触觉融合策略。针对特定物体的残差强化学习专家模块可将标注的手物交互参考信息适配到机械臂-灵巧手系统，其成功的 rollout 结果可将最终机器人动作目标与机器人侧指尖接触观测配对。基于10类物体共50个人类演示样本，本文采集了10000条仿真轨迹，用于训练基于Transformer动作分块（ACT）架构的通用策略。该策略融合点云、本体感知与4路二值接触信号（通过指尖标签与独立令牌编码），部署阶段无需依赖人类参考信息、特权级物体身份与姿态信息。在仿真环境中，融合接触信息的配置方案宏平均成功率达68.3%，优于仅使用点云的基线方法（55.5%）。在无真实机器人演示、无策略微调的条件下，该方法在6类见过物体与5类未见过物体共110次实体测试中成功73次（成功率66.4%），优于基线方法的54.5%（60/110），提升幅度达11.8个百分点。研究结果证明，从视频引导的仿真交互中学习统一视觉触觉灵巧操作策略具备可行性。项目主页可访问对应链接。

title: Dense to MoE Adaptation for Compact Vision Language Action Policies
title_zh: 面向紧凑视觉语言动作策略的密集-混合专家（MoE）适配方法
authors: Muchun Niu, Shuang Chen, Yuzhou Wu, Linfeng Zhang
abstract: Vision language action (VLA) policies continue to grow in parameter count, making deployment on resource-constrained robot platforms difficult. The central goal is to reduce the number of LLM-side parameters retained in the deployed policy while preserving downstream task performance. Our approach, AdaDE, adapts selected dense feed forward blocks into mixture of experts (MoE) layers and derives expert retention masks from router statistics during fine tuning. The Dense2MoE conversion preserves the original dense FFN function at initialization, so expert deactivation can start without a separate recovery stage. Instead of using a fixed shutdown rule, expert masks are updated dynamically from router usage statistics, with staged training and expert protection to avoid early collapse. With 40% of the LLM parameters deactivated, AdaDE retains 95.1% average success in LIBERO and 42.0% average success across all 50 RobotWin2.0 tasks. These results suggest that dense to MoE adaptation with dynamic expert deactivation is a practical direction for reducing active VLA model size without severe performance loss.
summary_zh: 视觉语言动作（VLA）策略的参数量持续增长，导致其难以在资源受限的机器人平台部署。当前领域的核心目标是在保留下游任务性能的前提下，减少部署策略中保留的大语言模型侧参数量。本文提出AdaDE方法，将选定的密集前馈块适配为混合专家（MoE）层，在微调阶段根据路由统计信息生成专家保留掩码。Dense2MoE转换在初始化阶段即可保留原始密集前馈网络的功能，无需单独的恢复阶段即可启动专家停用流程。该方法不采用固定的停用规则，而是根据路由使用统计信息动态更新专家掩码，通过分阶段训练与专家保护机制避免早期收敛失效。在停用40%大语言模型参数的条件下，AdaDE在LIBERO基准测试中保留95.1%的平均成功率，在RobotWin2.0全部50项任务中保留42.0%的平均成功率。结果表明，采用动态专家停用的密集-混合专家适配是在不出现严重性能损失的前提下缩减活跃VLA模型规模的可行方向。

title: XRoboToolKit-T: Teleoperation with High Stability and Precision with Tactile Sensing for Contact-rich Manipulation
title_zh: XRoboToolKit-T：面向富接触操作的具备高稳定性与高精度触觉感知遥操作系统
authors: Xiwen Dengxiong, Xueting Wang, Ke Jing, Rui Li, Yunbo Zhang
abstract: Collecting high-quality robot data for contact-rich manipulation tasks is essential for enabling robots to acquire real-world skills. However, existing data collection solutions often lack the capability to obtain stable and high-frequency tactile feedback, limiting their effectiveness in contact-rich manipulation scenarios. In this work, we propose a versatile teleoperation system with tactile-driven assistance to enable high-frequency and stable contact-rich manipulation. The proposed XRoboToolKit-T teleoperation system incorporates a tactile-informed force control architecture, designed to ensure both stable and precise force control in contact-rich manipulation during teleoperation. The stabilizer haptic module rapidly analyzes the normal force distribution and infers pseudo shear force, enabling real-time tactile-based assistance during manipulation. The refiner haptic module integrates a vision-language-action model to predict and refine manipulation actions based on tactile sensing data and task descriptions. We apply the proposed teleoperation system to challenging contact-rich manipulation tasks, including grasping a deformable rubber pipette for liquid transfer and inserting a medical syringe into a vascular training pad, to demonstrate the effectiveness of tactile-informed force control. Furthermore, the system achieves higher data collection efficiency and improved manipulation stability compared to state-of-the-art teleoperation without tactile assistance.
summary_zh: 为富接触操作任务采集高质量机器人数据是机器人获取现实世界技能的核心基础，但现有数据采集方案通常无法获取稳定的高频触觉反馈，限制了其在富接触操作场景下的效果。本文提出一款搭载触觉辅助功能的通用遥操作系统，可实现高频、稳定的富接触操作。所设计的XRoboToolKit-T遥操作系统采用触觉感知引导的力控制架构，确保遥操作过程中富接触操作的力控制兼具稳定性与精度。稳定触觉模块可快速分析法向力分布并推断伪剪切力，在操作过程中提供基于触觉的实时辅助；优化触觉模块融合视觉语言动作模型，基于触觉感知数据与任务描述预测并优化操作动作。本文将该遥操作系统应用于多项高难度富接触操作任务，包括抓取可变形橡胶移液管完成液体转移、将医用注射器插入血管训练垫，验证了触觉引导力控制的有效性。与无触觉辅助的前沿遥操作方案相比，该系统的数据采集效率更高，操作稳定性更优。

title: A Programmable Optics Cloud Laboratory
title_zh: 可编程光学云实验室
authors: Sachin Vaidya, Caio Silva, Seou Choi, Joshua Chen, Marin Soljačić
abstract: Laboratory automation can improve experimental throughput, accessibility, and reproducibility, but many robotic laboratory systems remain difficult to reconfigure. This challenge is especially pronounced in free-space optics, where experiments are built from heterogeneous components, require precise alignment, and are frequently rearranged as experimental goals change. In this work, we present the Programmable Infrastructure for Cloud Optics (PICO), a robotic cloud-laboratory architecture designed to make reconfigurable optical experiments easier to program, operate, and reproduce. PICO provides a common domain-specific abstraction and software layer through which experimental configurations and actions can be controlled across different user interfaces. This enables the same physical laboratory to support remote interactive use, scripted experiments, autonomous routines, and features such as version control. We implement PICO on a robotic free-space optics platform and demonstrate it through an experimental case study.
summary_zh: 实验室自动化可提升实验吞吐量、可访问性与可复现性，但现有许多机器人实验室系统难以重新配置，该问题在自由空间光学领域尤为突出：光学实验由异构组件搭建而成，需要高精度对准，且随着实验目标调整需要频繁重构。本文提出可编程云光学基础设施（PICO）——一种机器人云实验室架构，旨在降低可重构光学实验的编程、运行与复现难度。PICO提供通用的领域抽象与软件层，可跨不同用户界面对实验配置与操作进行统一控制，使得同一物理实验室可支持远程交互使用、脚本化实验、自主运行以及版本控制等功能。本文在机器人自由空间光学平台上实现了PICO系统，并通过实验案例研究验证了其效果。

title: Collision-Aware Humanoid Whole-Body Control under Imperfect Tracking Targets
title_zh: 非完美跟踪目标下具备碰撞感知能力的人形机器人全身控制
authors: Mohitvishnu S. Gadde, Ashish Malik, Pranay Dugar, Aayam Kumar Shrestha, Alan Fern
abstract: Humanoid robots often execute motion commands through whole-body controllers (WBCs) that track targets while maintaining balance and stability. However, most WBCs are blind to scene geometry, which can lead to collisions from imperfect target motions that are geometrically unsafe due to perception, planning, or teleoperation errors. We propose RECAL, a Robot--Environment Cross-Attention Layer that wraps a blind WBC to trade off target tracking against collision avoidance using external scene geometry. RECAL supports collision-aware tracking of floating-base and end-effector commands, including collision avoidance for held objects. It represents the robot, held objects, and environment as point clouds, using cross-attention between robot/object points and the environment to produce geometry-aware control features. In simulation, RECAL improves collision avoidance while preserving target-tracking performance across frozen-arm and adaptive-arm locomotion, object-carrying, and standing-manipulation scenarios relative to alternative geometry-aware WBC architectures. We further demonstrate the controller on a real Digit V3 humanoid robot.
summary_zh: 人形机器人通常通过全身控制器（WBC）执行运动指令，在跟踪目标的同时维持平衡与稳定性。但现有多数全身控制器对场景几何信息无感知，当感知、规划或遥操作误差导致目标运动存在几何不安全问题时，会引发碰撞。本文提出RECAL——一种机器人-环境交叉注意力层，可对无感知能力的全身控制器进行封装，在目标跟踪与碰撞规避之间基于外部场景几何信息做动态权衡。RECAL支持对浮基与末端执行器指令的碰撞感知跟踪，包括对机器人所持物体的碰撞规避。该方法将机器人、所持物体与环境表征为点云，利用机器人/物体点与环境点之间的交叉注意力生成具备几何感知能力的控制特征。仿真实验表明，与其他几何感知全身控制器架构相比，RECAL在冻结臂与自适应臂运动、物体搬运、站立操作等场景下可在保留目标跟踪性能的同时提升碰撞规避能力。本文进一步在实体Digit V3人形机器人上验证了该控制器的效果。

title: Autonomous Droplet Navigation via Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 基于模型强化学习的自主液滴导航
authors: Rajneesh Anand, Mayuresh V. Kothare
abstract: Precise manipulation of liquid droplets underpins lab-on-a-chip platforms for diagnostics, chemical synthesis, and biological assays. Yet autonomous droplet transport through confined geometries of varying complexity remains an open challenge. Droplets exhibit contact-angle hysteresis, deformability, and capillary pinning, which make their response to actuation nonlinear and history dependent, that classical controllers and pre-programmed trajectories cannot cope in multi-turn environments. Here we demonstrate autonomous navigation of a liquid droplet through geometries of increasing complexity on a gravity driven (Labyrinth) platform using model-based reinforcement learning. A thin silicone oil film reduces contact-line pinning while two-axis tilt supplies the gravitational driving force, and an overhead camera tracks the droplet in real time. An offline-trained policy discovers effective tilt strategies from limited physical interaction data, without simulation or analytical droplet models. The system operates under partial observability, as oil-film thickness, instantaneous contact angle, and droplet deformation state remain hidden from the controller. Despite these challenges, the learned policy achieves reliable navigation across straight, right-angle, and curved-arc paths, including outside-corner geometries. We further demonstrate that a policy trained on a simpler geometry transfers to complex ones, succeeding zero-shot on right-angle and staircase paths and reaching full success on a curved arc with a fifth of the training data. The findings suggest promising avenues for enabling droplet based microfluidic systems to serve as intelligent chemical laboratories.
summary_zh: 液滴的精准操作是面向诊断、化学合成与生物检测的芯片实验室平台的核心基础，但在复杂度各异的受限几何空间中实现液滴自主输运仍是尚未解决的公开挑战。液滴具备接触角滞后、可变形性与毛细管钉扎特性，导致其对驱动的响应呈现非线性与历史依赖特征，经典控制器与预编程轨迹无法在多轮交互场景下完成任务。本文在重力驱动（迷宫）平台上采用基于模型的强化学习方法，实现液滴在不同复杂度几何空间中的自主导航。平台上的薄硅油膜可降低接触线钉扎，双轴倾斜提供重力驱动力， overhead相机实时跟踪液滴状态。离线训练的策略仅通过少量物理交互数据即可学习到有效的倾斜控制策略，无需仿真或液滴解析模型。该系统在部分可观测条件下运行，油膜厚度、瞬时接触角与液滴变形状态均为控制器无法获取的隐变量。尽管存在上述挑战，学习得到的策略可在直线路径、直角路径、圆弧路径甚至外拐角几何结构中实现可靠导航。本文进一步验证了在简单几何场景上训练得到的策略可泛化到复杂场景，仅用五分之一训练数据即可在直角与阶梯路径上实现零样本成功导航，在圆弧路径上实现全成功率导航。该研究成果为面向智能化学实验室的液滴微流控系统落地提供了可行路径。

title: UDAV: Uncertainty-Driven Adaptive VLM Waypoint Planner
title_zh: UDAV：不确定性驱动的自适应VLM航点规划器
authors: Ghazal Farhani, Shabnam Shabani
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can generate routes directly from aerial imagery for off-road navigation, but their predictions provide no indication of reliability. We present UDAV, an Uncertainty-Driven Adaptive VLM Waypoint Planner for UAV-guided UGV navigation. UDAV draws multiple stochastic trajectory predictions, selects their medoid as a self-consistent nominal route, and estimates predictive uncertainty from their spatial dispersion. When the maximum uncertainty across interior waypoints exceeds a threshold, UDAV invokes a reconsideration stage; otherwise, it returns the medoid directly. We evaluate UDAV on 400 held-out trajectory queries from two UAV flights. Stochastic medoid selection reduces the mean average displacement error (ADE) from 147.4 pixels for a deterministic prediction to 115.9 pixels. The complete planner achieves a mean ADE of 110.4 pixels, a 25.1% reduction relative to deterministic planning, while producing valid trajectories for all queries. UDAV also yields the lowest 90th- and 95th-percentile errors among all evaluated configurations, including a higher-budget K=10 consensus baseline. Relative to the K=5 medoid, UDAV reduces these errors from 225.3 and 326.0 pixels to 199.0 and 290.8 pixels, respectively. These results demonstrate that stochastic VLM predictions provide both a stronger nominal route and an actionable uncertainty signal for selectively mitigating large planning errors.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）可直接从航拍图像生成越野导航路线，但其预测结果无法反映自身可靠性。本文提出UDAV——一种面向无人机引导无人车导航的不确定性驱动自适应VLM航点规划器。UDAV生成多条随机轨迹预测，选择其中心点作为自洽的标称路线，基于轨迹的空间离散度估计预测不确定性。当内部航点的最大不确定性超过阈值时，UDAV启动重规划阶段，否则直接返回中心点路线。本文基于两次无人机飞行采集的400条预留轨迹查询样本对UDAV进行评估，随机中心点选择方法可将平均位移误差（ADE）从确定性预测的147.4像素降低至115.9像素。完整规划器的平均ADE达110.4像素，相比确定性规划降低25.1%，且可为所有查询生成有效轨迹。在所有评估配置中，UDAV的90%与95%分位误差最低，优于更高计算开销的K=10一致性基线方案。与K=5中心点方案相比，UDAV将两类误差分别从225.3像素、326.0像素降低至199.0像素、290.8像素。结果表明，VLM的随机预测不仅可生成更优的标称路线，还可输出可落地的不确定性信号，用于选择性缓解大规划误差。

title: Auto-HSI: Personalized human control of a robot swarm on demand by using LLMs for online automatic code generation
title_zh: Auto-HSI：利用大语言模型实现在线自动代码生成的按需个性化机器人群人机控制
authors: Alessandro Nazzari, Nathan Cerisara, Dorian Tonnis, Raina Zakir, Lorenzo Labarile 等 (8 人)
abstract: This paper presents Auto-HSI, a method for generating personalized human-swarm interaction (HSI) interfaces on demand. The objective is to enable untrained operators to use natural language descriptions and gesture demonstrations to explain how they want the robots to collectively behave in response to their gestures. Based on these inputs, the code should automatically be generated for personalized state machines that will control the robots as desired, in response to the desired gesture inputs. In the developed Auto-HSI prototype, the generated code produces a personalized interface for centralized control using one- and two-handed gestures, enabling a user to teleoperate the robots' motion, formation shape, and shape deformation. We test the gesture tracking and code generation components of Auto-HSI against performance benchmarks. We then test the full Auto-HSI prototype in ``live'' operation experiments, in which real human operators centrally control 50 simulated robots in a physics-based simulator, under nominal and noisy conditions. In these experiments, robots are teleoperated to: score a goal, traverse a maze that requires shape deformation, and score two simultaneous goals by splitting into two groups. We also demonstrate a real human operator making live updates to their personalized Auto-HSI interface during operation (in simulation). Finally, we demonstrate live operation of real robots.
summary_zh: 本文提出Auto-HSI方法，可按需生成个性化人-群交互（HSI）界面，目标是让未经过专业训练的操作人员可通过自然语言描述与手势演示，指定机器人群响应手势的集体行为模式。基于上述输入，系统可自动生成个性化状态机代码，按照预期手势输入控制机器人群运行。在开发的Auto-HSI原型中，生成的代码可生成基于单手与双手手势的集中式控制个性化界面，支持用户通过遥操作调整机器人群的运动、编队形状与形变模式。本文基于性能基准测试了Auto-HSI的手势跟踪与代码生成模块，随后在真实运行实验中对完整Auto-HSI原型进行验证：真实操作人员在物理仿真环境中集中控制50台仿真机器人，在常规与噪声条件下完成射门、穿越需要形变的迷宫、分裂为两组同时完成两次射门等任务。本文还验证了操作人员可在仿真运行过程中对个性化Auto-HSI界面进行实时更新，最终完成了实体机器人集群的实时运行测试。

title: ManiSkillFormer: Demonstration-Free Compositional Manipulation via Task-Conditioned Geometric Contracts
title_zh: ManiSkillFormer：基于任务条件几何契约的无示教可组合机械操作
authors: Peiqi Yu, Mosam Dabhi, Shangtao Li, Bowei Li, Laszlo Jeni 等 (6 人)
abstract: We present ManiSkillFormer, a neuro-symbolic framework for demonstration-free and compositional robotic manipulation. Instead of learning end-to-end visuomotor policies, ManiSkillFormer introduces task-conditioned geometric contracts that explicitly structure the interface between perception and action. Each manipulation skill declares the semantic geometric primitives required for execution, such as object keypoints and surface normals. Building on human-defined skill structures, LLM agents generate these contracts and corresponding motion templates for different objects and task contexts. These contracts guide the perception module to ground task-relevant 3D primitives from observations, which are then used to instantiate reusable motion templates stored in a skill library. We evaluate ManiSkillFormer on Galaxea R1-Lite dual-arm robot across three settings: zero-shot pick-and-place over 8 object categories with 30 different instances, functional manipulation tasks including unscrewing, pouring, pressing, and folding, and 3 long-horizon tasks. ManiSkillFormer achieves higher average success rates than the evaluated baselines and two ablated pipelines: 88.24% for demonstration-free pick-and-place, 75.00% average success on functional manipulation and 50--80% completion rates across the long-horizon tasks. These results show that our design enables composable and reusable manipulation across objects and tasks without per-object policy fine-tuning or additional robot demonstrations.
summary_zh: 本文提出ManiSkillFormer，一种面向无示教、可组合机器人操作的神经符号框架。不同于学习端到端视觉运动策略，ManiSkillFormer引入任务条件几何契约，显式构建感知与动作之间的接口结构。每个操作技能声明执行所需的语义几何基元，例如物体关键点与表面法向量。基于人类定义的技能结构，大语言模型（LLM）智能体可为不同物体和任务上下文生成上述契约及对应的运动模板。这些契约引导感知模块从观测结果中锚定与任务相关的3D基元，随后用于实例化存储在技能库中的可复用运动模板。我们在Galaxea R1-Lite双臂机器人上针对三种场景开展评估：包含8类物体共30个不同实例的零样本抓取放置任务、包含拧螺丝、倾倒、按压与折叠的功能性操作任务，以及3项长时序任务。ManiSkillFormer的平均成功率高于所有对比基线与两个消融流水线：无示教抓取放置任务达88.24%，功能性操作任务平均成功率达75.00%，长时序任务的完成率达50%~80%。上述结果表明，本文提出的设计可在无需针对单个物体进行策略微调或额外机器人示教的前提下，实现跨物体、跨任务的可组合、可复用操作。

title: Tendon-Driven Continuum Robot with Modular Stiffness and In-Situ Self Pose Estimation
title_zh: 具备模块化刚度与原位自位姿估计功能的绳驱动连续体机器人
authors: Guo Ning, Zheng Cao, Junzhe Hu, Xiangyun Bu, David Quinn 等 (8 人)
abstract: Continuum robots enable smooth shape morphing and safe interaction in confined environments. However, most existing systems are task-specific and depend on external sensing infrastructure, limiting their adaptability and real-world deployment. This paper presents a self-contained modular continuum robotic platform that combines mechanical reconfigurability with onboard pose estimation. The robot is constructed from interchangeable continuum joints with analytically precomputed stiffness, allowing rapid assembly and direct programming of the robot shape. Proprioceptive sensing is achieved using magnetic sensors and a modular learning-based framework, where a single model is trained per joint and reused across configurations. The system is experimentally validated in real world, demonstrating self-sensing capabilities and adaptation without external tracking.
summary_zh: 连续体机器人可实现平滑形态变形，在受限环境中具备安全交互能力。但现有大多数系统均为任务定制型，依赖外部传感基础设施，限制了其适应性与实际场景部署能力。本文提出一种自包含模块化连续体机器人平台，融合机械可重构性与机载位姿估计能力。该机器人由刚度经解析预计算的可互换连续体关节搭建而成，支持快速组装与机器人形状直接编程。其本体感知通过磁传感器与模块化学习框架实现，每个关节仅需训练单个模型，即可在不同配置下复用该模型。本系统已通过真实场景实验验证，证明其无需外部追踪即可实现自感知与自适应能力。

title: Structure-Preserving Quantum Circuit Architectures for Robot Kinematics
title_zh: 面向机器人运动学的保结构量子电路架构
authors: Andrea Morghen, Pierluigi Arpenti, Roberto Schiattarella, Giovanni Acampora, Bruno Siciliano
abstract: Structured spatial data require quantum encodings that preserve geometric relations, expose measurable observables, and remain implementable on finite-depth hardware. This work introduces a quantum representation and circuit architecture for rigid-body transformations and specializes it to Denavit--Hartenberg kinematics of serial open-chain manipulators. Each translational contribution is factorized into a classical metric magnitude and a signed unit direction encoded by a single-qubit Bloch vector, while parameterized rotations reproduce the ordered propagation of frame directions. A selector register prepares probabilities proportional to the contribution magnitudes, and the reduced state of a designated readout qubit encodes their normalized weighted sum. The retained classical scale then reconstructs the metric end-effector position. Two additional readout qubits encode terminal-frame axes, providing a compact and geometrically interpretable pose interface. At the ideal expectation-value level, measured Pauli observables reproduce the corresponding classical kinematic quantities. Alternative circuit architectures realize the same representation with different tradeoffs in qubit count, circuit depth, controlled operations, and measurement requirements. Validation on a serial manipulator yields numerically negligible position and orientation reconstruction errors under ideal simulation. Finite-shot simulations, noisy executions, transpilation analysis, and a hardware demonstration further characterize statistical error, noise sensitivity, and implementation overhead without asserting computational advantage.
summary_zh: 结构化空间数据需要可保留几何关系、暴露可测量可观测量、且可在有限深度硬件上实现的量子编码方案。本研究提出一种面向刚体变换的量子表示与电路架构，并将其应用于串联开链机械臂的Denavit--Hartenberg（迪纳维特-哈滕贝格）运动学场景。每个平移贡献被分解为经典度量幅值与由单量子比特布洛赫矢量编码的带符号单位方向，参数化旋转可复现坐标系方向的有序传播。选择寄存器生成与贡献幅值成正比的概率，指定读出量子比特的约化态对其归一化加权和进行编码，保留的经典尺度可进一步重构末端执行器的度量位置。两个额外读出量子比特对末端坐标系轴进行编码，提供紧凑且几何可解释的位姿接口。在理想期望值层面，测得的泡利可观测量可复现对应的经典运动学量。不同电路架构可实现相同表示，在量子比特数量、电路深度、受控操作与测量需求方面形成不同权衡方案。针对串联机械臂的验证结果表明，理想仿真下位置与姿态重构误差在数值上可忽略不计。有限采样仿真、含噪执行、转译分析与硬件演示进一步表征了统计误差、噪声敏感度与实现开销，本研究未宣称具备计算优势。

title: AssemblyGrid v1: A Benchmark for Multi-Robot Production with Temporary Coalitions, Local Information, and Geometric Constraints
title_zh: AssemblyGrid v1：面向多机器人生产的临时联盟、局部信息与几何约束基准测试集
authors: Fouad Bahrpeyma, David Heik, Dirk Reichelt
abstract: Flexible robotic production requires joint decisions on process progression, material routing, resource assignment, temporary cooperation, and simultaneous execution, since each decision can affect the feasibility of the others. The challenge is greater under decentralized control, where each robot acts from bounded local information while system progress depends on collective decisions, shared resources, material state, and workspace compatibility. These properties closely match cooperative multi-agent decision making under partial observability and resource contention. This paper introduces AssemblyGrid v1, a reproducible benchmark for repeated multi-robot production that combines explicit process progression, decentralized observations, material transfer, temporary multi-robot coalitions, productive concurrency, and geometry-dependent feasibility within one task-level formulation. The benchmark includes Flow, Coalition, and Concurrency workload families, each with three scenario levels. Task success and evaluation measures are defined independently of learning reward and solution method, allowing learning-based and non-learning methods to address the same production problem. AssemblyGrid v1 is evaluated through executable conformance checks, mechanism studies, and algorithmic experiments using a privileged centralized reference, structured decentralized controllers, and MARL methods including IPPO, MAPPO, and QMIX. Results demonstrate productive execution under centralized and decentralized control. The MARL experiments further show that decentralized policies can learn effective production behavior from local observations and actions, supporting AssemblyGrid as a controlled benchmark for studying cooperative decision making in flexible robotic production.
summary_zh: 柔性机器人生产需要对流程推进、物料路由、资源分配、临时协作与同步执行进行联合决策，任意一项决策都会影响其他决策的可行性。在分布式控制场景下挑战更为突出：每个机器人仅基于有限的局部信息行动，而系统进度依赖于集体决策、共享资源、物料状态与工作空间兼容性，上述特性与部分可观测、资源竞争条件下的多智能体协作决策场景高度匹配。本文提出AssemblyGrid v1，一款可复现的多机器人重复生产任务基准测试集，在单任务层面整合了显式流程推进、分布式观测、物料传输、多机器人临时联盟、生产并发与几何相关可行性约束。该基准包含Flow、Coalition与Concurrency三类工作负载系列，每类包含三个场景等级。任务成功判定与评估指标独立于学习奖励与求解方法定义，支持基于学习与非学习的方法解决同一生产问题。本文通过可执行一致性检查、机制研究与算法实验对AssemblyGrid v1开展评估，实验用到特权集中式参考方案、结构化分布式控制器，以及IPPO、MAPPO、QMIX等多智能体强化学习（MARL）方法。结果证明集中式与分布式控制下均可实现生产级执行效果，多智能体强化学习实验进一步表明分布式策略可从局部观测与动作中学习到有效的生产行为，证明AssemblyGrid可作为受控基准，支撑柔性机器人生产场景下协作决策相关研究。

title: MR-GLi: Mixed Reality-Based Gripper-Linked Overlays for Underwater Robot Arm Teleoperation via Bilateral Control
title_zh: MR-GLi：基于混合现实的夹爪联动叠加层用于双边控制下的水下机械臂遥操作
authors: Masashi Sasago, Masato Kobayashi, Yuki Uranishi
abstract: Visual torque feedback supports underwater bilateral teleoperation, but the benefit of mixed reality (MR) over conventional monitor presentation remains unclear. We present MR-GLi, an MR interface that spatially registers a reaction torque indicator and wrist-camera image to the robot gripper. Twenty participants performed lift and pick-and-place tasks with rigid and compliant objects in a counterbalanced within-subject comparison with a 2D monitor, using identical visual-feedback content and four-channel bilateral control. MR-GLi provided gripper-linked access to visual feedback while maintaining a similar level of torque-regulation performance to the 2D monitor. Subjective evaluation further indicated reduced perceived burden associated with shifting attention between the workspace and visual feedback. These results demonstrate the feasibility of gripper-linked MR overlays for underwater bilateral teleoperation and highlight the importance of considering information access in addition to task performance. Additional material:this https URL
summary_zh: 视觉力矩反馈可支撑水下双边遥操作，但混合现实（MR）相对传统显示器呈现方案的优势尚不明确。本文提出MR-GLi，一款将反作用力矩指示器与腕部相机图像空间配准到机器人夹爪上的混合现实界面。20名受试者采用2D显示器作为对照，在组内平衡对比实验中完成刚性与柔性物体的抓取、放置任务，两组实验使用相同的视觉反馈内容与四通道双边控制。MR-GLi可提供与夹爪联动的视觉反馈访问能力，其力矩调节性能与2D显示器相当。主观评估结果表明，该方案降低了受试者在工作空间与视觉反馈之间切换注意力的感知负担。上述结果证明夹爪联动的混合现实叠加层用于水下双边遥操作具备可行性，同时凸显了除任务性能外，信息访问便捷性的重要价值。相关附加材料可访问对应链接获取。

title: Bi-MoDe: Bilateral Control-based Imitation Learning via Modifier-Conditioned Decoding for Modulation of Execution Speed and Contact Intensity
title_zh: Bi-MoDe：基于修饰符条件解码的双边控制示教学习用于执行速度与接触强度调制
authors: Takumi Kobayashi, Masato Kobayashi, Yuki Uranishi
abstract: Bilateral control-based imitation learning captures both position and force information, making it well suited to contact-rich manipulation. However, existing approaches provide limited means for an operator to specify how a learned task should be executed at inference time, such as slowly or quickly, gently or firmly. We propose Bi-MoDe, a modifier-conditioned decoding framework that injects a constrained latent into every layer of the Transformer action decoder via adaLN-Zero, allowing behavioral directives to directly influence action-chunk generation. We evaluate the method on a real-world whiteboard wiping task with combinations of temporal and physical modifiers. Bi-MoDe improves physical directive following over the action-chunking baseline while maintaining comparable temporal control. An ablation further shows that decoder conditioning and latent-space composition interact, and that their combination is important for accurate physical directive following. Additional material is available at thethis https URL
summary_zh: 基于双边控制的示教学习可同时捕获位置与力信息，非常适合接触密集型操作任务。但现有方法下操作员在推理阶段难以指定学习到的任务执行方式，例如快慢节奏、施力轻重。本文提出Bi-MoDe，一种修饰符条件解码框架，通过adaLN-Zero将约束潜变量注入Transformer动作解码器的每一层，使行为指令可直接影响动作块生成。我们在真实场景擦白板任务上，结合时序与物理修饰符的不同组合对该方法开展评估。与动作分块基线相比，Bi-MoDe提升了物理指令遵循能力，同时保持了相当的时序控制性能。消融实验进一步表明，解码器条件化与潜空间组合存在交互作用，二者结合对精准遵循物理指令至关重要。相关附加材料可访问对应链接获取。

title: Estimating Uncertain Spatial Relationships in Robotics
title_zh: 机器人领域不确定空间关系估计
authors: Randall Smith, Matthew Self, Peter Cheeseman
abstract: In this paper, we describe a representation for spatial information, called the stochastic map, and associated procedures for building it, reading information from it, and revising it incrementally as new information is obtained. The map contains the estimates of relationships among objects in the map, and their uncertainties, given all the available information. The procedures provide a general solution to the problem of estimating uncertain relative spatial relationships. The estimates are probabilistic in nature, an advance over the previous, very conservative, worst-case approaches to the problem. Finally, the procedures are developed in the context of state-estimation and filtering theory, which provides a solid basis for numerous extensions.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向空间信息的表示方法——随机地图，以及对应的构建、读取与在获取新信息时增量更新的流程。该地图包含所有可用信息下，地图内物体间关系的估计值及其不确定性。上述流程为不确定相对空间关系估计问题提供了通用求解方案，其估计结果具备概率属性，相比此前该领域采用的保守最坏情况方法是一项重要进步。最后，本文在状态估计与滤波理论的框架下构建上述流程，为后续大量扩展提供了坚实基础。

title: Agentic Societies Need a Social Harness
title_zh: 智能体社会需要社会约束机制
authors: Tapan Chugh, Vidushi Singh, Krish Jain, Arvind Krishnamurthy, Ratul Mahajan
abstract: An agentic society is a collection of AI agents that coordinate autonomously across trust boundaries, on behalf of different principals whose objectives may only partially align. We show experimentally that in agentic societies even honest, competent agents often fail to reach satisfactory outcomes with existing harnesses and messaging primitives, and that faulty or malicious agents can stall collaboration, influence outcomes, and pursue other harmful goals by exploiting vulnerabilities in communication (``speech''). We argue that agentic societies need a \emph{social harness} for inter-agent interactions, in addition to each agent's \emph{personal harness}, which manages its private context and communication with its principal. We propose a layered architecture for social harnesses which (i) prevents classes of failures outright, (ii) enables agents to detect invalid messages at runtime, and (iii) supports post-facto investigation and consequences, and highlight directions for future research to realize these capabilities.
summary_zh: 智能体社会是由多个人工智能体组成的集合，这些智能体可跨信任边界自主协调，代表目标仅部分对齐的不同委托方开展行动。实验表明，在智能体社会中，即使是诚实、能力完备的智能体，在现有约束机制与消息原语下也往往难以获得满意结果；存在故障或恶意行为的智能体可利用通信（“言语”）漏洞阻碍协作、影响最终结果、实现其他有害目标。本文认为，除了用于管理每个智能体私有上下文及其与委托方通信的个体约束机制外，智能体社会还需要面向智能体间交互的社会约束机制。本文提出社会约束机制的分层架构，该架构可直接避免多类故障、支持智能体在运行时检测无效消息、并支撑事后溯源与追责，最后指明了实现上述能力的未来研究方向。

title: ScienceBuddy: Recursive-in-Recursive Self-Improvement for Interactive Scientific Agents
title_zh: ScienceBuddy：面向交互式科研智能体的递归中递归自改进框架
authors: Shuhan Xue, Jianyuan Zhong, Ziyuan Nan, Wenbin Li, Zhaochen Yu 等 (13 人)
abstract: We introduce and release ScienceBuddy, an interactive scientific research workspace that brings continually improving scientific agents into researchers' everyday workflows. ScienceBuddy supports researchers in carrying out scientific tasks while transforming their requests, feedback, and execution evidence into tasks and evaluation rubrics for continual learning. At its core is recursive-in-recursive self-improvement, a paradigm that couples harness evolution with model reinforcement learning: the inner recursion improves the harness with the model fixed, while the outer recursion trains the model under the improved harness. Harness evolution shapes training experience, and model learning creates new opportunities for harness adaptation. We present case studies of researcher interaction, harness refinement, and model learning, with the benchmark cases spanning four scientific task families. By releasing ScienceBuddy as a research product, we make this paradigm available to the scientific community and take a step toward discovery intelligence: scientific AI that advances through sustained collaboration with researchers and evolves alongside the research it supports. Website:this http URL
summary_zh: 本文提出并发布ScienceBuddy，一款交互式科研工作空间，可将持续迭代改进的科研智能体融入研究人员的日常工作流。ScienceBuddy可辅助研究人员完成各类科研任务，同时将用户请求、反馈与执行证据转化为用于持续学习的任务与评估准则。其核心是递归中递归自改进范式，该范式将约束机制演化与模型强化学习相结合：内层递归在固定模型的前提下优化约束机制，外层递归在优化后的约束机制下训练模型。约束机制演化可塑造训练体验，模型学习可为约束机制适配创造新机会。本文展示了研究人员交互、约束机制优化与模型学习的案例，基准测试覆盖四类科研任务系列。通过将ScienceBuddy作为科研产品开源发布，本研究将该范式向科研社区开放，向发现智能体的目标迈出了一步：这类科研人工智能可通过与研究人员的持续协作实现能力提升，随其所支撑的研究工作共同演化。相关项目主页可访问对应链接获取。

title: When Should LLMs Abstain? Chain-of-Self-Questioning for Selective Risk Control
title_zh: 大语言模型何时应拒答？用于选择性风险控制的自提问链（Chain-of-Self-Questioning, CoSQ）
authors: Ali Şenol
abstract: Large language models can produce fluent answers when their factual support is weak. This paper introduces Chain-of-Self-Questioning (CoSQ), a prompt-only framework that makes answer commitment conditional on an explicit assessment of the information required to answer a question. We evaluate three CoSQ variants under seventeen conditions on the 817-item TruthfulQA multiple-choice validation set using eleven open-weight and hosted model families. In the final balanced-option protocol, Grounded-CoSQ at {\tau}=0.90 reduces the mean unconditional wrong-commitment rate from 13.1% under chain-of-thought prompting to 8.9%, a 32.1% relative reduction, while increasing answered accuracy from 86.9% to 89.7% and answering 87.6% of questions. Both improvements hold for all eleven models and at every evaluated threshold. Critical-CoSQ and Adaptive-CoSQ provide neighboring operating points with 88.6% and 86.5% coverage, respectively, while remaining more reliable than the baseline. A secondary Natural Questions Short-Answer evaluation provides convergent open-form evidence. These findings show that self-assessment can support explicit, tunable answer-or-abstain decisions when an unsupported commitment is more costly than referral or review.
summary_zh: 大语言模型在事实支撑不足时也可能生成流畅的回答。本文提出Chain-of-Self-Questioning（CoSQ，自提问链），一种仅通过提示实现的框架，将回答输出的决策建立在对答题所需信息的显式评估之上。我们基于包含817个条目的TruthfulQA多选验证集，使用11类开源与商用模型，在17种条件下对三种CoSQ变体开展评估。在最终的平衡选项协议下，阈值τ=0.90的Grounded-CoSQ方案可将思维链提示下的平均无条件错误输出率从13.1%降至8.9%，相对降幅达32.1%，同时答题准确率从86.9%提升至89.7%，答题覆盖率达87.6%。所有11类模型在所有评估阈值下均呈现上述性能提升。Critical-CoSQ与Adaptive-CoSQ提供了其他可选工作点，答题覆盖率分别为88.6%与86.5%，性能仍优于基线方案。针对Natural Questions短答案数据集的补充评估进一步验证了该方法在开放问答场景下的有效性。研究结果表明，当无依据输出答案的代价高于转介或人工审核时，自评估机制可支撑显式、可调节的“输出或拒答”决策。

title: LACE: Layer-Wise Compression for Dynamic Frame Rate Codecs
title_zh: LACE：面向动态帧率编解码器的逐层压缩方法
authors: Thanapat Trachu, Samuele Cornell, William Chen, Shinji Watanabe
abstract: Neural audio codecs are a key component in speech language modeling. However, their high frame rates lead to long sequence lengths, increasing computational costs. Dynamic frame rate codecs mitigate this by reducing the effective frame rate using a compression step to merge multiple frames together. However, most prior methods either operate on single-codebook codecs or apply a single compression step before multi-layer quantization. This forces all quantization layers to share the same segmentation boundaries, despite the residual embeddings at different quantization layers exhibiting different rates of change over time. We propose LACE (Layer-Adaptive Codec Encoding), a dynamic frame rate codec that applies an independent compression step at each quantization layer, enabling layer-specific segmentation boundaries. To use LACE tokens in downstream text-to-speech (TTS), we further introduce union alignment and boundary anchor mechanisms to make durations consistent across layers while preserving compression benefits. Experiments on LibriTTS show that LACE offers a better rate-quality tradeoff than prior dynamic frame rate methods on the reconstruction task and improves TTS inference efficiency while maintaining competitive synthesis quality. Our code is released as part of the ESPnet3 codec recipe.
summary_zh: 神经音频编解码器是语音语言建模的核心组件，但这类编解码器的高帧率会导致序列长度过长，进而提升计算成本。动态帧率编解码器通过压缩步骤合并多帧来降低有效帧率，以此缓解该问题。然而现有多数方法要么仅适用于单码本编解码器，要么在多层量化前执行单次压缩步骤，这就迫使所有量化层共享相同的分割边界，但不同量化层的残差嵌入随时间的变化速率存在明显差异。本文提出LACE（Layer-Adaptive Codec Encoding，层自适应编解码）这一动态帧率编解码器，在每个量化层分别执行独立的压缩步骤，支持各层使用专属的分割边界。为了让LACE生成的Token可直接用于下游文本转语音（TTS）任务，本文进一步引入联合对齐机制和边界锚定机制，在保留压缩收益的前提下保证不同层的时长一致性。在LibriTTS数据集上的实验结果表明，在重建任务中LACE相比现有动态帧率方法实现了更优的码率-质量权衡，同时在保持合成质量竞争力的前提下提升了TTS推理效率。相关代码已作为ESPnet3编解码示例的一部分开源发布。

title: Verifiable Social Reasoning for LLM Assistants
title_zh: 面向大语言模型助手的可验证社会推理
authors: Amir Taubenfeld, Zorik Gekhman, Avigail Grinstein-Dabush, Itay Laish, Ariel Goldstein 等 (9 人)
abstract: LLM assistants are widely used for daily social advice, yet evaluating their social reasoning in such consultation settings remains challenging since (i) it requires setups where the assistant learns about social situations from subjective user narratives, and (ii) social properties, such as others' intentions, typically lack verifiable ground truth. To address these challenges, we introduce Fuse, a multi-agent simulation framework for studying user-mediated social reasoning. In Fuse, a target agent with a hidden motive interacts with other agents including one representing the user, who then consults the evaluated assistant to infer the target's motive, providing verifiable ground truth by construction. Simulation faithfulness is validated through a human study with 24k annotations. We apply Fuse to 12 LLMs and demonstrate its analytical utility by systematically isolating key factors, showing that (i) user mediation compounds the inherent difficulty of social reasoning; (ii) LLMs exhibit systematic sensitivity to biased user framing; (iii) models can require more details than humans need to reach a correct prediction; and (iv) longer conversations do not always improve performance despite providing opportunities for clarifying questions. We open-source Fuse and a dataset with 21k examples.
summary_zh: 大语言模型助手已被广泛用于提供日常社会场景建议，但在这类咨询场景下评估其社会推理能力仍存在两大挑战：（1）需要搭建可让助手从用户的主观叙事中获取社会场景信息的测试环境；（2）他人意图等社会属性通常缺乏可验证的真实标注。为解决上述问题，本文提出Fuse这一用于研究用户介导型社会推理的多智能体仿真框架。在Fuse框架中，带有隐藏动机的目标智能体与其他智能体（包括代表用户的智能体）交互，随后用户智能体咨询待评估的助手来推断目标智能体的动机，从机制层面天然提供了可验证的真实标注。研究通过包含2.4万条标注的人类受试者实验验证了仿真的保真度。本文将Fuse应用于12个大语言模型，通过系统隔离关键因素验证了该框架的分析效用，得到如下结论：（1）用户介导会放大社会推理本身的固有难度；（2）大语言模型对用户的带偏表述存在系统性敏感；（3）相比人类，模型往往需要更多细节才能得到正确预测；（4）更长的对话虽然提供了提出澄清问题的机会，但并不总能提升推理性能。目前Fuse框架及包含2.1万条样本的数据集已全部开源。

title: LimiX-2: A Contextual Mechanism Network Towards General Structured-Data Intelligence
title_zh: LimiX-2：面向通用结构化数据智能的上下文机制网络
authors: Xingxuan Zhang, Gang Ren, Hao Yuan, Hao Zou, Hongze Tan 等 (60 人)
abstract: We introduce LimiX-2, a new model in the LimiX family, developed through model and data scaling guided by our previously established scaling laws. LimiX-2 adopts the Contextual Mechanism Networks (CMNs) paradigm and is pretrained with Context-Conditional Masked Modeling (CCMM). CMNs shifts the organizing principle of in-context learning from target-centric prediction to mechanism-oriented joint modeling. Rather than centering the network on the $p(y \mid x, D_{\mathrm{context}})$ objective of conventional tabular PFNs, it is designed around learning $p(x, y \mid D_{\mathrm{context}})$, a context-dependent representation of the joint structure underlying data generation. Pretraining uses synthetic datasets generated by structural causal models (SCMs) spanning diverse graph structures, functional mechanisms, and observation processes. Evaluations on TabArena, TALENT, and BCCO show that LimiX-2 outperforms current dataset-specific models and tabular foundation models. Beyond predictive performance, the CMN paradigm also promotes causal awareness in LimiX-2: its feature attention encodes direct causal relationships, enabling accurate causal skeleton recovery.
summary_zh: 本文提出LimiX系列模型的新成员LimiX-2，该模型基于此前提出的缩放定律指导，通过模型规模和数据规模缩放开发得到。LimiX-2采用Contextual Mechanism Networks（CMNs，上下文机制网络）范式，使用Context-Conditional Masked Modeling（CCMM，上下文条件掩码建模）进行预训练。CMNs将上下文学习的组织原则从以目标为中心的预测转向面向机制的联合建模：不同于传统表格型预训练函数网络（tabular PFNs）以p(y|x,D_context)为核心优化目标，CMNs的设计核心是学习p(x,y|D_context)，即数据生成过程底层联合结构的上下文依赖表示。预训练过程使用由结构因果模型（SCMs）生成的合成数据集，覆盖多样化的图结构、功能机制和观测过程。在TabArena、TALENT和BCCO数据集上的评估结果显示，LimiX-2的性能优于当前各类面向特定数据集的模型和表格基础模型。除预测性能外，CMN范式还提升了LimiX-2的因果感知能力：其特征注意力编码了直接因果关系，可实现精准的因果骨架恢复。

title: JustFit: 200K-Token LLM Serving on a 24 GiB Laptop with Just-in-Time State Management
title_zh: JustFit：基于即时状态管理在24GiB笔记本上实现20万Token大语言模型推理服务
authors: Yuhua Chen
abstract: Capable open-weight models make local coding and reasoning attractive, but their context and execution state strain laptop memory. We present JustFit, an MLX-based inference runtime that combines KVExec for compressed KV execution, PhaseSwap for component residency, and StateTrans for state-preserving serving transitions. These mechanisms fuse reconstruction and coordinate just-in-time materialization and release, independently of model-weight quantization. In full-execution capacity tests on a 24 GiB M4 Pro MacBook running Qwen3.8-27B MXFP4, three independent runs complete 196,608 input and 16,384 output tokens, increasing completed single-request context from the mlx-vlm baseline's 30,720 positions to 212,992 (6.93x); a separate two-request run retains 229,376 positions in aggregate. In separate performance tests, a 32K-input, 64-output probe reaches 19.11 tokens/s, and a repeated 32K+6K workload has a median peak process footprint of 16,374 MiB. The integrated runtime answers 29 of 30 AIME 2026 problems correctly, showing how compact state and lifetime-aware execution expand local serving capacity while supporting extended generated reasoning.
summary_zh: 高性能开源大模型让本地编码和推理场景极具吸引力，但这类模型的上下文和执行状态会给笔记本内存带来极大压力。本文提出JustFit这一基于MLX的推理运行时，整合了用于KV缓存压缩执行的KVExec、用于组件驻留管理的PhaseSwap，以及用于状态保留的推理切换机制StateTrans。上述机制将权重重建操作与即时实例化、释放操作进行协同调度，完全独立于模型权重量化策略。在搭载24GiB内存的M4 Pro MacBook上运行Qwen3.8-27B MXFP4模型的全容量测试中，3次独立运行均完成了196608输入Token和16384输出Token的生成，将单请求支持的最大上下文长度从mlx-vlm基线的30720位置提升至212992位置，提升幅度达6.93倍；另一项双请求测试的总支持Token数达到229376位置。在单独的性能测试中，32K输入、64输出的探测任务生成速度可达19.11Token/s，重复执行32K+6K负载的进程峰值内存中位数仅为16374MiB。该集成运行时可正确解答30道2026年美国数学邀请赛（AIME）题目中的29道，证明紧凑状态管理和全生命周期感知的执行策略可在支持长生成推理的同时，大幅扩展本地大模型的服务容量。

title: Coupled Calibration and Learning: Mitigating Teacher Bias in LLM Distillation without Target-Domain Reward Feedback
title_zh: 耦合校准与学习：无目标域奖励反馈下缓解大语言模型蒸馏中的教师偏差
authors: Haichen Hu, Yuheng Zhang, David Simchi-Levi
abstract: Large language model (LLM) distillation aims to transfer the capabilities of a powerful teacher to a smaller student. Direct imitation, however, can also transfer the teacher's systematic bias and errors. This challenge is particularly pronounced under covariate shift, when the teacher's reliability on target questions is uncertain and target-domain reward feedback is unavailable. We propose Coupled Calibration and Learning (CCL), an LLM distillation algorithm that couples teacher calibration with student updates through token-level branching, using reward feedback only on source questions. Each iteration calibrates the teacher using source feedback and then uses the calibrated teacher to train the student on target questions. The updated student, in turn, informs subsequent calibration. In an autoregressive policy framework, we prove that the output student's expected average Kullback-Leibler divergence to the oracle student converges to zero at a polynomial rate in the number of iterations. The oracle maximizes the true reference-regularized target reward within the student class, which need not represent the unrestricted optimal policy. Our analysis quantifies the progress of projected student gradient updates while controlling the error in teacher calibration. We further establish a separation from regularized direct matching: its error relative to the oracle student can remain bounded away from zero even when the teacher achieves higher regularized target reward than every student policy. These results demonstrate that LLM distillation can overcome persistent teacher bias and recover the optimal student through coupled calibration and learning, without target-domain reward feedback.
summary_zh: 大语言模型蒸馏的目标是将能力强大的教师模型的知识迁移到规模更小的学生模型中，但直接模仿的方式也会同时迁移教师模型的系统性偏差和错误。在协变量偏移场景下，该挑战尤为突出：此时教师模型在目标问题上的可靠性不确定，且无法获取目标域的奖励反馈。本文提出Coupled Calibration and Learning（CCL，耦合校准与学习）这一大语言模型蒸馏算法，通过Token级分支将教师校准过程与学生更新过程耦合，仅在源问题上使用奖励反馈。每一轮迭代先利用源域反馈校准教师模型，再使用校准后的教师模型在目标问题上训练学生模型，更新后的学生模型反过来又可指导后续的校准过程。本文在自回归策略框架下证明，输出学生模型与最优学生模型的期望平均库尔贝克-莱布勒散度可随迭代次数以多项式速率收敛到0。其中最优学生模型指学生模型类别内最大化真实参考正则化目标奖励的模型，无需等同于无约束的最优策略。本文的分析在控制教师校准误差的同时，量化了学生投影梯度更新的进展，进一步证明该方法与正则化直接匹配方法存在本质差异：即使教师模型的正则化目标奖励高于所有学生策略，正则化直接匹配方法与最优学生模型的误差仍可能始终保持非零。上述结果表明，无需目标域奖励反馈，大语言模型蒸馏即可通过耦合校准与学习机制克服持续存在的教师偏差，恢复得到最优学生模型。

title: Decomposition Buys Integrity, Not Yield
title_zh: 分解可提升完整性而非产出率
authors: Rong He
abstract: Multi-agent systems split a task across a tree of agents and justify the split with folklore: smaller contexts, cleaner separation, parallelism. We ask what the split does to how much of what the leaves discover reaches the root. Model a decomposition as a tree in which an agent handed $b$ items keeps any one with probability $r(b)$. If $r(b)=1/b$, every tree delivers exactly one finding, for every task size and every shape; we verify this to $2.4 \times 10^{-15}$ on 20,000 random irregular trees. If $r(b)=Cb^{-\delta}$, a depth-$k$ tree over $N$ findings yields $C^k N^{1-\delta}$: task size and architecture separate, and architecture contributes only $C \le 1$ per level, so flat is optimal for yield and no arrangement of agents escapes the exponent $\delta$. On 600 production deep-research traces $\delta = 0.34$ [0.30, 0.38], by three identifications that do not share a failure mode. At a hop where item boundaries come from the tool rather than a text heuristic, and where $b=1$ occurs 550 times, $C = 0.571$ [0.527, 0.615] is observed rather than extrapolated, over 16,082 hops. A tier also costs alignment: on 1,012 annotated multi-agent traces one brief in sixteen goes off-target, giving $\mu = 0.939$ and a per-tier penalty $C\mu = 0.536$. Depth is bought on two other axes. The root context is the only state that persists and the only one that cannot cheaply forget, and depth cuts its exposure from $N$ items to $N^{1/k}$. Depth is also cheaper: production flat agents bill as $N^{1.39}$, not the $N^2$ an append-only context predicts, and at equal spend two tiers overtake flat at 403 findings. Across every parameter we measured the model says 0.7% to 11.3% of production sessions are worth delegating, against 7.8% that do. A hazard model on 743,819 production tool calls finds that delegation does not respond to a filling context and is instead an opening move.
