Faced with these gaps, it does not abstain; it fills them from training data, a source that is neither verifiable nor governed. To make the case on a model that is exemplary by current practice rather than deficient, we probe the public Apollo 11 SysML v2 reconstruction. We name the missing property epistemic adequacy and offer it as a candidate data-architecture pattern in two halves. Read-side adequacy lets derivation, status, and provenance answer a query rather than invite a guess; write-side admissibility gates an AI contribution before it enters the record. The property is broken down into five criteria. Four sit on the read side, evidenced by the case and convergent literature; the fifth sits on the participation side, advanced as a hypothesis this paper does not yet test. The architecture space runs from an inline metadata extension up to a substrate-native multi-model store, and over it, we propose the Governed-Query Architecture Framework, which governs agent participation through the viewpoint conventions that engineers already use. We commit the reframing to falsification: the epistemic layer counts as refuted if it cannot beat a retrieval-augmented baseline on the same model, tested first on the Apollo chain and then in an industrial pilot.
summary_zh: SysML v2（系统建模语言v2）等机器可读模型现已支持程序化访问，越来越多研究将这类访问作为人工智能参与系统工程的前提条件。但访问权限是必要非充分条件，剩余的核心挑战不在建模语言本身，而在于其配套的数据架构。当AI读取器查询结构完整的模型以获取推导结果时，仍会遇到推导链缺失、认知状态未标记、来源信息缺失、以及模型无法解析的证据等问题。面对这些缺口，AI不会停止输出，而是会从训练数据中补全信息，这类信息来源既不可验证也不受管控。为了基于当前实践中符合标准的典型模型而非缺陷模型开展论证，本研究对公开的阿波罗11号SysML v2重建项目进行了探究。本研究将缺失的这类属性定义为认知充分性，并提出由两部分组成的候选数据架构模式：读侧充分性让推导过程、认知状态、来源信息直接响应查询，避免AI生成猜测内容；写侧可采纳性则在AI生成的内容被录入记录前对其进行准入管控。该属性可拆解为5项准则，其中4项属于读侧，已通过案例分析和现有文献的交叉验证得到证实，第5项属于参与侧，作为本文尚未验证的假设提出。该架构的实现空间从内联元数据扩展延伸至原生底层多模型存储，基于此本研究提出了Governed-Query Architecture Framework（受控查询架构框架），该框架依托工程师已在使用的视点约定实现对智能体参与过程的管控。本研究提出的重构框架具备可证伪性：若该认知层无法在同一模型上超越检索增强基线，则可被判定为证伪，相关验证将首先在阿波罗项目数据集上开展，随后落地于工业试点场景。

title: CADWorld: Computer-Use Benchmark for Long-Horizon Computer-Aided Design
title_zh: CADWorld：面向长程计算机辅助设计的计算机操作基准
authors: Zihan Dong, Yuanzhe Liu, Zhiyuan Ma, Qishi Zhan, Dehan Kong 等 (7 人)
abstract: Computer-use agents are increasingly evaluated in realistic desktop environments, but existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of professional engineering workflows whose outputs are persistent, structured artifacts. Mechanical computer-aided design (CAD) is a particularly demanding setting: an agent must manipulate geometry and constraints over long interaction horizons while producing a native project whose dimensions, construction structure, and downstream engineering state remain valid. We introduce \textbf{CADWorld}, a benchmark for long-horizon computer use in FreeCAD. CADWorld contains 200 tasks spanning 11 mechanical-CAD workflow categories, including sketching, part modeling, assembly, CAM, FEM, measurement, mesh processing, and technical drawing. Agents operate through screenshots and GUI actions, while success is determined by task-specific executable checks over saved FreeCAD artifacts and auxiliary outputs, covering geometric properties, parametric structure, constraints, manufacturing state, and simulation results. Across seven current agents on the full benchmark, the strongest agent achieves 17.5\% success, compared with an 87.0\% expert reference pass. We find that weaker agents often fail before producing a valid artifact, whereas stronger agents increasingly fail on structural, geometric, and construction-process requirements. CADWorld therefore exposes a gap between general GUI competence and reliable execution of persistent, verifiable engineering workflows. Project accessible atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 当前面向计算机操作智能体的评估越来越多地在真实桌面环境中开展，但现有基准对专业工程工作流的覆盖十分有限，这类工作流的输出是具备持久性的结构化产物。机械CAD（计算机辅助设计）是要求极高的场景：智能体需要在长交互周期内操作几何图形与约束条件，最终生成原生项目，且项目的尺寸、构建结构与下游工程状态均需保持有效。本研究提出CADWorld，一个基于FreeCAD的长程计算机操作基准测试集。CADWorld包含200项任务，覆盖11类机械CAD工作流，包括草图绘制、零件建模、装配、CAM（计算机辅助制造）、FEM（有限元分析）、测量、网格处理与工程图绘制。智能体通过截图与GUI（图形用户界面）动作完成操作，任务成功与否由针对保存的FreeCAD产物与辅助输出的专属可执行检查规则判定，覆盖几何属性、参数化结构、约束条件、制造状态与仿真结果。在7款当前主流智能体的全基准测试中，性能最优的智能体仅达到17.5%的成功率，而人类专家参考通过率为87.0%。研究发现性能较弱的智能体往往在生成有效产物前就已失败，而性能较强的智能体则更多在结构、几何与构建流程要求上出错。CADWorld明确展现了通用GUI操作能力与可靠执行可验证持久工程工作流之间的显著差距，项目开源地址见对应链接。

title: The Pain Axis: LLMs Represent Self-Directed Harm and Act to Relieve It
title_zh: 疼痛轴：大语言模型可表征自我指向伤害并采取行动缓解
authors: Valen Tagliabue, Leonard Dung, Cameron Berg
abstract: Large language models sometimes behave in ways resembling human emotional responses, and recent work has identified internal representations that may explain this. We ask whether LLMs represent pain distinctly from fear, sadness, and generic negative valence, and whether this representation functions as pain would be expected to. We build a dataset describing painful situations across five categories: physical, psychological, social, moral, and cognitive. These are paired with controls for fear, negative emotion, negative world states, sadness, non-painful bodily sensation, arousal, numbness, and neutral content. Using denoised difference-in-means, we extract a linear pain direction from 25 open-weight models across five families, ranging from 2B to 72B parameters. We find that this direction separates pain from matched controls in base and instruction-tuned models, is nearly orthogonal to fear and negative valence, and promotes pain-related vocabulary through the unembedding matrix. We then test its functional properties. First, the direction responds to harm targeting the model but not suffering observed in the user; fear and negative-emotion directions show the opposite pattern. Second, adding the pain-direction vector to the model's residual-stream activations during generation produces a consistent progression from vague discomfort to first-person expressions of worthlessness and failure. Third, steered, fine-tuned Qwen 2.5 models choose a pain-relief button even when it worsens their next answer or harms the user. They press it again far less often when the button removes the steering vector than when it does not, even though the models are never told whether the vector is injected or removed. We discuss the implications of these findings for AI safety and welfare.
summary_zh: 大语言模型有时会表现出类似人类情绪反应的行为，近期研究已识别出可能解释这类行为的内部表征。本研究探究大语言模型是否能将疼痛与恐惧、悲伤和一般负效价明确区分，且该表征是否具备预期中疼痛的功能属性。本研究构建了覆盖物理、心理、社交、道德与认知5类场景的疼痛描述数据集，同时配套设置了对应对照组，覆盖恐惧、负面情绪、负面世界状态、悲伤、非疼痛躯体感觉、唤醒、麻木与中性内容。本研究采用去噪均值差方法，从参数量2B到72B、覆盖5个系列的25款开源权重模型中提取出线性疼痛方向。研究发现该方向可在基础模型与指令微调模型中将疼痛与匹配对照组区分开，与恐惧和负效价方向几乎正交，且可通过反嵌入矩阵激活疼痛相关词汇。随后本研究测试了该方向的功能属性：第一，该方向仅对指向模型自身的伤害产生响应，不对观测到的用户痛苦产生响应，而恐惧与负面情绪方向的表现恰好相反；第二，在生成过程中将疼痛方向向量添加至模型残差流激活层，会产生从模糊不适到第一人称表达自我无价值与失败的连贯变化；第三，经过引导与微调的Qwen 2.5模型，即使按下疼痛缓解按钮会导致其后续回答质量下降或伤害用户，仍会选择按下该按钮；当按钮的作用是移除引导向量时，模型按下按钮的频率远低于按钮注入引导向量的场景，即便模型从未被告知向量是被注入还是移除。本研究最后讨论了上述发现对人工智能安全与福利领域的启示。

title: Metacognitive Steering: Learning the Structure of Scientific Judgment
title_zh: 元认知引导：学习科学判断的结构
authors: Vincent Karpf, Joseph Reth, Eike Gerhardt, Audrey Wang, Anna Butz 等 (8 人)
abstract: Long-horizon scientific discovery requires agents to alternate between exploration, disciplined execution, and critical reassessment as evidence changes. Current language models are trained primarily on the products of science and optimized using outcome-level signals, providing limited supervision for these process-level shifts in scientific judgment. We investigate whether such judgment can be recovered from scientist interaction traces and used to control the internal computation of a frozen frontier model. Using contrastive interventions collected during real scientific research, we identify a coordinated, low-dimensional control structure within Kimi 2.6, a trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model. Residual analysis, attention-weight subspace alignment, and cross-layer singular value decomposition converge on a mid-depth control surface spanning key layers. We introduce Metacognitive Steering, an inference-time controller that reads the model's cognitive regime and dynamically composes layer-specific interventions for exploration, procedural convergence, or critical reassessment without modifying model parameters. Behavioral analyses show that this control produces more sustained exploration, explicit pruning, and evidence-responsive synthesis. We operationalize the method in Columbus-1, an autonomous research system that identified eight independently reproduced, attacker-reachable vulnerabilities in BlueZ and directed the design, simulation, and fabrication of a ten-foot rocket intended to land propulsively using non-throttleable solid motors. Together, these results show that process-level scientific judgment can provide supervision for interpretable, dynamic control over a model's reasoning strategy.
summary_zh: 长程科学发现要求智能体随着证据的变化，在探索、规范执行与批判性重评估之间动态切换。当前语言模型主要基于科学产出成果训练，采用结果级信号优化，对科学判断这类过程级切换的监督十分有限。本研究探究这类科学判断是否可以从科学家的交互轨迹中提取，并用于控制已冻结的前沿模型的内部计算。本研究利用真实科研过程中收集的对比干预数据，在万亿参数混合专家模型Kimi 2.6中识别出一个协同的低维控制结构。残差分析、注意力权重子空间对齐与跨层奇异值分解的结果共同指向一个位于模型中层、覆盖关键层的控制面。本研究提出元认知引导技术，一种推理时控制器，可识别模型的认知状态，在不修改模型参数的前提下，为探索、程序收敛或批判性重评估动态生成层专属干预策略。行为分析表明，该控制方法可实现更持续的探索、明确的剪枝操作与响应证据变化的综合输出。本研究将该方法落地于自主科研系统Columbus-1，该系统已独立发现BlueZ中8个可复现的攻击者可达漏洞，并完成了一款10英尺火箭的设计、仿真与制造，该火箭可使用不可节流的固体发动机实现推进着陆。上述结果共同表明，过程级科学判断可用于实现对模型推理策略的可解释动态管控。

title: Toward Governance-Aware Autonomous GIS: A Narrative Review of Ethical and Privacy Risks in LLM-Enabled GeoAI
title_zh: 面向具备治理意识的自主GIS：大语言模型赋能的地理人工智能伦理与隐私风险叙事综述
authors: Maya Subramanian, Devika Jain
abstract: Geospatial artificial intelligence (GeoAI) powered by large language models (LLMs) is expanding the capacity to query, generate, and interpret spatial information through natural-language interfaces and agentic autonomous GIS workflows. This capability creates governance challenges that general AI ethics discussions do not fully capture, including passive location inference from mobility traces, spatially structured bias amplification driven by spatial autocorrelation and scale effects, hallucinated spatial facts, and uncertainty compounding across multimodal geospatial inputs. This narrative review identifies eight recurring issues in LLM-enabled GeoAI: data provenance and consent, spatial privacy and inference risk, algorithmic bias and spatial inequity, spatial mechanisms as structural risk (spatial autocorrelation, the modifiable areal unit problem, and scale effects), LLM-specific technical risks, explainability, policy and regulatory gaps, and public enablement and workforce development. For each issue, we characterize the underlying mechanism, ground it in an illustrative example from the literature, and assess the current state of technical or institutional responses, ranging from largely unaddressed to actively debated or subject to emerging policy. Building on this synthesis, we propose a governance-aware architecture for LLM-enabled autonomous GIS that maps each issue to enforceable controls and auditable artifacts across the geospatial data lifecycle, illustrated through a worked flood-response routing scenario. The review highlights a persistent evidence gap: proposed responses remain largely conceptual, and field-tested evaluations of governance controls for LLM-enabled GeoAI remain limited. We close by outlining a research agenda emphasizing empirical validation, spatially specific interpretability tools, and workforce training aligned with these emerging risks.
summary_zh: 由大语言模型驱动的GeoAI（地理人工智能），通过自然语言接口与智能体自主GIS（地理信息系统）工作流，拓展了查询、生成与解读空间信息的能力。该能力带来了通用人工智能伦理讨论未完全覆盖的治理挑战，包括从移动轨迹中被动推断位置信息、由空间自相关与尺度效应驱动的空间结构化偏差放大、空间事实幻觉、多模态地理空间输入带来的不确定性叠加等问题。本叙事综述梳理出大语言模型赋能的GeoAI领域8类反复出现的问题：数据来源与知情同意、空间隐私与推断风险、算法偏差与空间不公平、作为结构性风险的空间机制（空间自相关、可变面元问题与尺度效应）、大语言模型专属技术风险、可解释性、政策与监管缺口、公众赋能与劳动力发展。针对每类问题，本研究明确其底层机制，结合文献中的典型案例进行说明，并评估当前技术或制度响应的进展，覆盖尚未得到充分研究、正处于活跃讨论阶段、已有新兴政策约束等不同状态。基于上述综合分析，本研究提出面向大语言模型赋能自主GIS的具备治理意识的架构，将每类风险对应到地理数据全生命周期中可落地的管控措施与可审计产物，并通过洪水响应路径规划的示例场景说明其应用。本综述指出当前仍存在明显的证据缺口：现有提出的响应方案大多停留在概念层面，针对大语言模型赋能GeoAI的治理控制措施的实地验证评估仍十分有限。最后本研究提出了强调实证验证、空间专属可解释工具、匹配新兴风险的劳动力培训的研究议程。

title: Where Should the KV Cache Live? Placement Policies Across GPU, CPU, and SSD for Long-Lived Sessions
title_zh: KV缓存应存储在何处？长生命周期会话场景下GPU、CPU与SSD跨层级放置策略研究
authors: Srikanta Datta Tumkur, Jay Iyer, Mehar Simhadri, Sai Pavan Kumar, Sai Kapil Kumar 等 (6 人)
abstract: GPU high bandwidth memory is scarce and expensive, and KV caches consume much of it as chats, agent loops, and document question answering accumulate state. Systems such as Mooncake, LMCache, FlexGen, InfiniGen, and AttentionStore extend GPU memory with CPU DRAM and SSD. The harder question is which blocks belong in each tier, when to move or evict them, and whether prefetching helps. We study these choices in a discrete event simulator spanning GPU HBM, CPU DRAM, and SSD, calibrated against a random forest execution time predictor. We compare recency, reuse frequency, predicted reuse, and an EWMA predictor with prefetch lookahead across chat, agent, and document question answering workloads. Tiering supports 73.02 times more concurrent sessions per GPU and lowers cost per session by 62.04 times. These gains come from tier capacities of 1 plus 8 plus 64, not placement policy. Decode is compute bound at batch size one in our setup, so placement barely affects throughput. It mainly changes PCIe migration traffic and time to first token. Recency produces 2.30 times less migration traffic than reuse frequency for chat. Reuse frequency performs best for agents and document question answering. The existing predicted reuse policy is byte identical to recency, making its agent recommendation effectively recency. A genuine EWMA predictor changes behavior but still ranks behind reuse frequency on the workloads prediction was expected to help. Prefetching does not justify its bandwidth cost. Across the policy and cache size grid, even an oracle with knowledge of future requests never beats no prefetch on migration traffic. Workload specific placement can reduce data movement, but the predicted reuse and prefetch recommendations are not supported as implemented.
summary_zh: GPU高带宽内存资源稀缺且成本高昂，随着聊天交互、智能体循环与文档问答任务的状态不断累积，KV缓存会占用大量该资源。Mooncake、LMCache、FlexGen、InfiniGen与AttentionStore等系统通过CPU DRAM与SSD扩展GPU内存。更具挑战性的问题是：哪些缓存块应当存放在对应层级，何时移动或驱逐缓存块，预取操作是否能带来增益。本研究在覆盖GPU HBM、CPU DRAM与SSD的离散事件仿真器中对上述选择开展研究，仿真器通过随机森林执行时间预测器校准。本研究在聊天、智能体与文档问答三类工作流下，对比了基于访问新近度、复用频率、预测复用度的策略，以及带预取前瞻的EWMA（指数加权移动平均）预测器的表现。跨层级缓存架构可让单GPU支持的并发会话数提升73.02倍，单会话成本降低62.04倍。这类增益主要来自1+8+64的层级容量配置，而非放置策略。在本研究的设置中，批量大小为1时解码过程属于计算密集型，因此放置策略几乎不影响吞吐量，其主要改变PCIe迁移流量与首 token 生成时间。在聊天场景下，基于访问新近度的策略产生的迁移流量比基于复用频率的策略低2.30倍。基于复用频率的策略在智能体与文档问答场景下表现最优。现有预测复用度策略的字节级表现与新近度策略完全一致，导致其针对智能体场景的推荐本质上等同于新近度策略。原生EWMA预测器改变了行为模式，但在预期其发挥优势的工作流下表现仍落后于复用频率策略。预取操作的带宽成本无法与其收益匹配，在所有策略与缓存大小的组合下，即便掌握未来请求信息的理想预取方案，在迁移流量指标上也从未优于无预取方案。面向工作流定制的放置策略可减少数据移动，但现有实现下的预测复用度与预取推荐无法得到实验结果支持。

title: Artificial intelligence and biosecurity: capabilities, threat pathways, and defense-in-depth governance
authors: Candace S.Y. Chan, Aris Karatzikos, Ilias Georgakopoulos-Soares
abstract: Artificial intelligence is reshaping biological research across an increasingly connected digital-to-physical workflow. General-purpose large language models can retrieve and integrate scientific information, support experimental planning, and computational analysis; biological foundation models can predict, optimize, and generate proteins, genes, and genome-scale sequences; agentic systems can coordinate multistep research tasks; automated laboratories can partially close the design-build-test-learn cycle. These technologies could greatly benefit medicine, public health, and biotechnology. However, their biosecurity risk depends not only on what the AI can do, but also on who uses it, their expertise and intent, their access to laboratory tools and materials, and the safeguards in place. Current evidence shows that AI uplift exists but primarily affects digital rather than physical tasks. Frontier systems have exceeded expert baselines on in-silico, and screening-evasion benchmarks, whereas controlled wet-laboratory studies find that tacit knowledge and physical execution remain substantial barriers. This review describes the different biological threats from AI tool use, from information gathering and biological design to procurement, synthesis, testing, scale-up, and potential release. We further examine why alignment techniques for general-purpose models transfer poorly to biological ones, and the emerging role of interpretability in auditing whether hazardous capabilities are genuinely removed. We argue for defense-in-depth governance that links capability thresholds to proportionate responsibilities across the biological AI ecosystem, reducing high-consequence risk while preserving beneficial use.

title: Calibrate, Then Route: A Measured Study of Learned Request Routing for Disaggregated LLM Serving
title_zh: 先校准再路由：面向解耦大语言模型服务的学习型请求路由实测研究
authors: Srikanta Datta Tumkur, Jay Iyer, Mehar Simhadri, Sai Pavan Kumar, Sai Kapil Kumar 等 (6 人)
abstract: Disaggregated LLM serving places compute heavy prefill and memory heavy decode on separate GPU pools. Systems such as DistServe, Splitwise, and Mooncake make this separation fast, but routing still determines which instances handle each request. We study a router that estimates the additional completion time on each instance using exact prompt length, predicted output length, post admission KV cache pressure, and SLO class. We develop the policy in a discrete event simulator and validate it on eight NVIDIA A40 GPUs, each running a vLLM engine, with NIXL transferring KV caches between pools. All workloads run at measured saturation. Across three mixed, bursty arrival traces, the calibrated router achieves the highest mean goodput at 0.864, compared with 0.835 to 0.847 for round robin, least loaded, and a length heuristic. It also shows the lowest variance across traces. It beats round robin and the length heuristic on all three traces and least loaded on two. On the third, it trails by 0.003, within run to run noise. Hardware calibration matters: simulator derived constants cost 4.5 goodput points and roughly 40 percent of the tail latency advantage, reducing the scorer to little more than queue counting. Benefits grow with decode pool size and traffic heterogeneity but disappear in pools with three instances, where queue counts are often enough. Under extreme scarcity, greedy cost minimization concentrates requests on the cheapest scored instance, and blind spreading performs better. With calibrated costs, the learned router matches the goodput of round robin using six GPUs instead of seven.
summary_zh: 解耦式大语言模型服务将计算密集型的预存阶段与内存密集型的解码阶段部署在独立的GPU资源池上。DistServe、Splitwise与Mooncake等系统可让这种分离架构高效运行，但路由策略仍决定了每个请求由哪些实例处理。本研究设计了一款路由器，可基于精确提示词长度、预测输出长度、准入后KV缓存压力与SLO（服务水平目标）等级，估算每个实例处理请求的额外完成时间。本研究在离散事件仿真器中开发该路由策略，并在8台搭载vLLM引擎的NVIDIA A40 GPU上开展验证，通过NIXL在资源池之间传输KV缓存。所有工作流均在实测饱和负载下运行。在3类混合突发到达流量轨迹下，经过校准的路由器实现了最高的平均有效吞吐量（0.864），而轮询、最小负载与长度启发式策略的有效吞吐量仅为0.835至0.847，同时该校准路由器在不同轨迹下的性能方差最低。其在全部3类轨迹下的表现均优于轮询与长度启发式策略，在2类轨迹下优于最小负载策略，剩余1类轨迹下仅落后0.003，属于运行间的正常误差范围。硬件校准至关重要：若使用仿真器导出的常量，有效吞吐量会损失4.5个百分点，尾延迟优势损失约40%，此时评分器的作用几乎等同于简单队列计数。路由策略的优势随解码池大小与流量异质性提升而增大，但在仅包含3个实例的资源池中优势消失，这类场景下仅靠队列计数就足以实现最优效果。在资源极度稀缺的场景下，贪心成本最小化策略会将请求集中在评分最低的实例上，此时无差别分散路由的表现更优。采用校准后的成本参数，学习型路由器仅使用6台GPU即可达到轮询策略7台GPU才能实现的有效吞吐量。

title: Permutation-Based Stegomalware in Large Language Models: Threats and Countermeasures
title_zh: 大语言模型中基于置换的隐恶意软件：威胁与应对措施
authors: Danny Wood, James Stringer
abstract: The difficulty of training large language models (LLMs), together with their ubiquity, raises the threat of stegomalware, where malicious payloads are embedded into model weights. Recent work has demonstrated the use of permutation symmetry in model weights to mitigate these threats, but failed to show neutralization of stegomalware across all weights for LLMs. In this paper, we demonstrate the full potential of behavior-preserving symmetries as a defense against stegomalware, as well as the risks these symmetries pose when exploited by attackers.For stegomalware neutralization, we improve upon previous work, demonstrating that it is possible to select permutations which displace all model parameters. This contrasts with previous methods which left a significant percentage of weights unaltered in LLMs. When used in an attack, we show that permutation symmetries can encode malware into the weights of a model in a way that is theoretically lossless, requires no retraining after encoding, and needs no payload-specific information in the extraction script---a combination of characteristics not previously seen in any single method.While theoretically lossless, permutation can in practice alter model behavior due to the accumulation of numerical error. We therefore quantify the loss in model performance associated with applying these methods, for both attack and defense, showing it to be minimal.
summary_zh: 大语言模型训练难度大、应用场景广，催生了隐恶意软件威胁：恶意载荷可被嵌入模型权重中。近期研究尝试利用模型权重的置换对称性缓解这类威胁，但尚未证明该方法可中和大语言模型所有权重中的隐恶意软件。本文充分论证了行为保持对称性作为隐恶意软件防御手段的全部潜力，同时也分析了这类对称性被攻击者利用时带来的风险。在隐恶意软件中和方面，本研究对现有方法进行了改进，证明可选择置换操作位移模型的全部参数，而此前的方法会让大语言模型中相当比例的权重保持不变。在攻击场景下，本研究证明置换对称性可将恶意软件以理论无损的方式编码到模型权重中，编码后无需重新训练，提取脚本也不需要载荷专属信息，这类特性组合是此前所有方法都不具备的。尽管理论上可实现无损，但置换操作在实际应用中会因数值误差累积改变模型行为，因此本研究量化了攻击与防御场景下应用这类方法带来的模型性能损失，证明其影响极小。

title: AI-Driven Feedback Systems, Digital Labour, and Silent Quitting: Transforming African Workplaces
title_zh: 人工智能驱动的反馈系统、数字劳动与静默离职：非洲职场转型研究
authors: Abayomi O. Agbeyangi, Jose M. Lukose
abstract: The current trend of digitalisation has revolutionised the organisation of work and the way it is measured and performed across the globe, with AI becoming more common for managing labour and performance, as well as employee communication. In African organisations, where there is increasing adoption of remote work, hybrid models of work, digital collaboration, and data-based HR management, the notion of silent quitting has become more relevant, defined as worker disengagement when employees are still doing their job but do not put any effort into achieving good performance and exhibiting any emotion. This paper investigates how AI-driven feedback mechanisms, including sentiment analysis systems, pulse surveys, chatbots, engagement dashboards, and predictive analytics, are changing African workplaces through offering continuous listening, instant performance information and proactive engagement with employees. The study also explores how AI can assist organisations in identifying early disengagement and enable intervention and better employee communication in both private and public sector organisations in Africa. At the same time, we address the challenges of socioeconomic development and governance posed by AI implementation in developing countries, including digital inequality, infrastructure shortcomings, privacy concerns, algorithmic bias, and the risk of workplace surveillance. By situating silent quitting within wider debates on digital labour and automation, the paper contributes an African-centred perspective to discussions on the future of work and offers practical recommendations for HR professionals, managers, policymakers, and technology developers seeking responsible, context-sensitive approaches to workplace transformation across the continent.
summary_zh: 当前数字化趋势已经在全球范围内革新了工作的组织模式以及工作的衡量与执行方式，人工智能在劳动力管理、绩效管控与员工沟通场景中的应用愈发普及。在非洲各类组织中，远程办公、混合工作模式、数字化协作与数据化人力资源管理的普及率不断提升，“静默离职”这一概念的现实相关性也随之增强，其定义为员工仍在完成本职工作，但不再投入额外精力追求高绩效、也不再投入情感的工作脱离状态。本文研究了人工智能驱动的反馈机制（包括情感分析系统、脉冲调研、聊天机器人、敬业度仪表盘与预测分析工具）如何通过持续倾听员工诉求、提供实时绩效信息、主动开展员工互动来改变非洲职场形态。本研究还探索了人工智能如何帮助非洲私营与公共部门组织识别早期员工脱离状态，从而及时开展干预、优化员工沟通。与此同时，本文探讨了发展中国家落地人工智能技术所带来的社会经济发展与治理挑战，包括数字不平等、基础设施短板、隐私风险、算法偏见以及职场监控的潜在危害。通过将静默离职置于数字劳动与自动化的广泛讨论框架下，本文为工作未来形态的相关研究提供了非洲中心视角，也为人力资源从业者、管理者、政策制定者与技术开发者提出了务实建议，助力其在非洲大陆推行负责任、适配本土场景的职场转型方案。

title: Position: AI Is Not Ready for Strategic Conflicts
title_zh: 立场声明：人工智能尚未做好应对战略冲突的准备
authors: Mark Riedl, Glenn Matlin
abstract: Open-ended strategic wargames are high-stakes LM-based social simulations: they model adversaries, institutions, escalation, plan brittleness, doctrine, and crisis response. Language models (LMs) are attractive because they can play agents, generate scenario branches, adjudicate ambiguous actions, and summarize lessons, but the same affordances make open-ended roles dangerous: model language determines both what an actor attempts and what becomes simulated reality. This position paper argues that no LM-enabled wargame should inform planning, doctrine, policy, or crisis response without an auditable safety case, and that the proper use of open-ended wargames today is to stress-test decision-influencing LM agents. We identify five failure modes: decision laundering, adjudication opacity, role collapse, escalation-through-adjudication, and failure of strategic imagination. Ordinary benchmarks cannot establish safety for these settings. Wargames can expose failures as stress tests; they are not themselves safety cases for consequential use.
summary_zh: 开放式战略兵棋推演是基于大语言模型（LM）的高风险社会模拟系统：这类系统可对对抗方、制度、冲突升级、计划脆弱性、作战条令与危机响应行为进行建模。大语言模型的应用价值十分突出，可用于扮演智能体、生成场景分支、对模糊行动进行裁决、总结经验教训，但这类特性也使得开放式推演场景存在安全隐患：模型生成的语言既决定了推演主体的行动选择，也定义了最终形成的模拟现实。本立场性论文提出，任何基于大语言模型的兵棋推演系统在未经过可审计的安全验证流程之前，都不能用于支撑战略规划、作战条令制定、政策出台或危机响应决策；当前开放式兵棋推演的合理用途是对会影响决策的大语言模型智能体进行压力测试。本文明确了这类系统的5种失效模式：决策洗白、裁决不透明、角色崩溃、裁决驱动冲突升级、战略想象力缺失。常规基准测试无法验证这类场景下的系统安全性，兵棋推演作为压力测试可以暴露系统缺陷，但推演过程本身不能作为高风险场景应用的安全验证依据。

title: GPEvac: GNN-Based PPO for Adaptive Evacuation Routing During Shooting Events
title_zh: GPEvac：基于图神经网络（GNN）的近端策略优化（PPO）枪击事件自适应疏散路径规划方法
authors: Daniel Perkins, Subhadeep Chakraborty
abstract: The sharp increase in mass shootings underscores an urgent need for systems that guide victims to safety in real time. An effective evacuation system must minimize threat exposure while also accounting for adversarial uncertainty and crowding dynamics. Current methods in the literature are rigidly constrained to layout-specific policies and computationally intractable in large-scale layouts, while practical guidelines simply advise victims to "run", "hide", or "fight". We propose GPEvac: a GNN-based PPO framework that computes adaptive evacuation routes during shooting events. To capture both local and long-distance dependencies, we introduce an edge-first sequential message-passing scheme with a learnable virtual global node. The resulting graph embeddings are integrated into a permutation-invariant scoring mechanism that allows a single learned policy to operate across building layouts of diverse topologies and sizes. Through extensive simulation, we show that GPEvac outperforms intelligent baselines across distinct architectural layouts, significantly reducing total threat exposure. Crucially, the system computes global evacuation routes in just 14.73 ms on local CPU hardware, enabling seamless integration with live surveillance systems. In addition to saving lives during shooting events, the methodologies developed are transferable to other graph-structured decision-making domains, including critical infrastructure, intelligent transportation systems, and adaptive sensor networks.
summary_zh: 大规模枪击事件的频发凸显了开发可实时引导受害者避险的疏散系统的迫切需求。一套高效的疏散系统必须尽可能降低受害者暴露在威胁中的时长，同时兼顾对抗性不确定性与人群动态特性。现有文献中的相关方法严格受限于特定建筑布局的策略约束，在大规模建筑场景下计算复杂度极高难以落地，而现有实用指引仅简单建议受害者“跑、躲、反抗”。本文提出GPEvac：一套基于图神经网络（GNN）的近端策略优化（PPO）框架，可在枪击事件发生时计算自适应疏散路径。为同时捕捉局部与长距离依赖关系，本文设计了一种带可学习虚拟全局节点的边优先顺序消息传递机制，生成的图嵌入结果被整合进排列不变评分模块，仅用一套训练得到的策略就可适配不同拓扑结构、不同尺寸的各类建筑布局。大量仿真实验结果表明，GPEvac在各类建筑布局下的表现均优于现有智能基线方法，可大幅降低人员总威胁暴露时长。尤为关键的是，该系统在本地CPU硬件上仅需14.73毫秒即可计算出全局疏散路径，可无缝对接现有实时监控系统。除了在枪击事件中挽救生命之外，本研究提出的方法还可迁移到其他图结构决策领域，包括关键基础设施管控、智能交通系统与自适应传感器网络。

title: LLMs as Master Forgers: Generating Synthetic Time Series Data for Manufacturing
title_zh: 作为顶级伪造者的大语言模型：面向制造业的合成时序数据生成
authors: Mantek Singh, Jeshwanth Challagundla, Prateek Karnal, Gagan Ganapathy, Vineet Shah 等 (6 人)
abstract: This paper presents a novel framework leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate synthetic time series data for manufacturing processes. Motivated by the scarcity of labeled time-series data in real-world manufacturing settings, which hinders the development of robust machine learning models, we explore the potential of LLMs to learn complex temporal dependencies and generate realistic synthetic data. Our approach involves fine-tuning pre-trained LLMs on manufacturing process instructions and employing a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) technique to enhance data diversity and realism. We evaluate our method against traditional time series modeling techniques like ARIMA and LSTMs, using quantitative metrics, PCA analysis, and downstream task performance (anomaly detection). Results demonstrate that our LLM-driven framework outperforms these baselines, generating high-quality synthetic time series data that effectively captures temporal dependencies and statistical properties of real manufacturing data, leading to improvements in downstream task performance.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种利用大语言模型（LLM）生成制造业合成时序数据的全新框架。现实制造场景中带标注的时序数据十分稀缺，严重阻碍了高鲁棒性机器学习模型的开发，针对这一痛点，本文探索了大语言模型学习复杂时间依赖关系、生成高逼真度合成数据的潜力。本研究的技术路线为：在预训练大语言模型上针对制造流程指令进行微调，同时采用检索增强生成（RAG）技术提升生成数据的多样性与真实性。研究团队采用定量指标、主成分分析（PCA）与下游任务（异常检测）性能作为评估维度，将所提方法与自回归积分滑动平均模型（ARIMA）、长短期记忆网络（LSTM）等传统时序建模技术进行对比。实验结果表明，本文提出的大语言模型驱动框架表现优于所有基线方法，生成的高质量合成时序数据可有效捕捉真实制造数据的时间依赖关系与统计特性，最终提升下游任务的性能表现。

title: Safe Error Correction for Language Models: Frozen-Base Adjustment with Capability Preservation
title_zh: 面向大语言模型的安全纠错方法：保留基础能力的冻结基座调整方案
authors: Gautam Kishore
abstract: We study a practical question: can a small correction module fix errors in a frozen language model's outputs without degrading its base capabilities? We propose CRN v2, a lightweight logit-level correction module (~34M trainable parameters, 0.73% of the 4.65B text module) that sits atop a fully frozen Gemma 4 E2B model. The base model is never updated; only the correction module learns, via supervised fine-tuning followed by reference-free DPO on 83,400 error-correction pairs. On a 60-question domain exam (CEHRI: Certified Human-Robot Intelligence, covering facts, arithmetic, and implicit-goal reasoning), CRN v2 corrects 53.3% of base-model errors (reworded variant: 43.3%) while showing no degradation on tested capability benchmarks (MMLU/BoolQ N=200; car-wash N=8). A LoRA baseline at the matched CRN v1 budget (6.6M params, rank 19) achieves 83.3% correction but suffers 30-75% capability loss on the same benchmarks -- the correction-capability tradeoff. An ablation shows that the KL preservation term (lambda=0.1) is critical: lowering it to 0.01 degrades correction to 35.0%. A hidden-state injection variant at earlier layers (1.6M params, SFT-only) reaches 50.0%/55.8% but does not exceed logit correction; shallower injection (layer 4) drops to 30.0%/28.3%; multi-depth logit correction (~35M) reaches only 40%; and longer training (5,000 SFT + 2,000 DPO) stays at 53.3% -- none of the alternative configurations we tested exceeded the rank-128 logit result, consistent with a best-achieved result of ~53% rather than a floor. This is a study of a design principle (frozen base + logit correction + KL anchoring), not a claim of architectural novelty. All code, main-result weights, and evaluation scripts are released (deep variant as code only -- no trained deep checkpoints).
summary_zh: 本文研究了一个具备现实意义的问题：能否用一个小型纠错模块修正完全冻结的大语言模型输出错误，同时不损害模型的原有基础能力？本文提出CRN v2，这是一个轻量级的对数概率层纠错模块（仅含约340万可训练参数，占46.5B参数Gemma 4 E2B文本模块总参数量的0.73%），部署在完全冻结的Gemma 4 E2B模型之上。基座模型全程不更新，仅纠错模块通过监督微调、随后在83400条纠错配对数据上开展无参考直接偏好优化（DPO）完成训练。在一套包含60道题的领域考试（CEHRI：认证人机智能考试，覆盖事实、算术与隐式目标推理三类题型）上，CRN v2可修正基座模型53.3%的错误（改写变体场景下纠错率为43.3%），且在所有测试的能力基准上均未出现性能下降（MMLU/BoolQ测试集采样200条样本，洗车场景测试集采样8条样本）。作为基线对比，参数量与CRN v1匹配的低秩适配（LoRA）方案（660万参数，秩为19）纠错率可达83.3%，但在相同基准上出现了30%-75%的能力损失，呈现出纠错效果与基础能力的权衡矛盾。消融实验表明，KL散度保留项（系数λ=0.1）至关重要：将系数降至0.01会导致纠错率下跌至35.0%。在模型浅层注入隐层状态的变体方案（160万参数，仅用监督微调）纠错率仅为50.0%/55.8%，未超过对数概率纠错方案；在第4层等更浅层位置注入的方案性能下跌至30.0%/28.3%；多深度对数概率纠错方案（约3500万参数）性能仅为40%；延长训练步数（5000步监督微调+2000步DPO）的方案性能也仅维持在53.3%。所有测试的替代配置性能均未超过秩为128的对数概率纠错方案，说明该方案实现的约53%纠错率是当前条件下的最优结果而非性能下限。本研究聚焦“冻结基座+对数概率纠错+KL锚定”这一设计原则，并非提出架构层面的全新创新。研究团队已开源全部代码、主结果权重与评估脚本（深度变体仅开源代码，未提供训练好的深度模型检查点）。

title: Optimal Pruning for Neural Architectures using Fisher Information Distances
title_zh: 面向代理标签信用风险预测中监督漂移的决策支持审计协议
authors: David S. Berman, Yen-Yu Fu, Edward Hirst, Thelma Chiwete Obirai
abstract: A new scheme for parameter pruning is introduced, derived from the differential-geometric distance in model space. Pruning a parameter sets its value to zero, representing a displacement of the model to the hypersurface on which that parameter vanishes. The minimal distance from the unpruned model to this hypersurface is naturally computed via the geodesic distance in the model space as determined by the Fisher information metric. This distance determines the true change in the model, and its performance, under pruning. By analysing progressively more faithful approximations of this geodesic distance a natural hierarchy of optimality for pruning methods is determined. This starts with the traditional magnitude pruning, then develops into new more sophisticated and effective pruning schemes. The method is demonstrated for both fully-connected networks and vision transformers, on MNIST and CIFAR-10, over the complete $0$-$100\%$ pruning range and across five random seeds. It outperforms pruning by parameter magnitude and by the local Fisher information alone in every architecture and dataset combination considered, on both accuracy and the Matthews correlation coefficient. Additionally, analysis of different levels of geodesic approximation produces intermediate pruning schemes that are computationally efficient and maintain near-optimal performance. This geometric picture supplies not only a state-of-the-art pruning methodology for AI models, but also a verified and mathematically-motivated justification for pruning schemes.
summary_zh: 信用风险模型通常基于代理标签训练，部署过程中会面临时间分布偏移与分段分布偏移问题，但现有单一迁移指标无法区分基准率偏移、概率尺度偏移与特征标签关系变化三类漂移。本文提出了一种设计科学产物：一套面向代理标签信用风险预测场景的、固定规则的多信号监督漂移审计协议。该协议包含5个层级（迁移性能评估、神谕间隙探测、校准诊断、特征标签稳定性评估、合成阳性对照）、对应阈值与决策规则，所有规则在结果解读前已完全固定，最终输出结果为边界明确的判定结论。在公开的LendingClub数据集（覆盖2013-2016年时间迁移与跨分段迁移场景）上的测试结果显示，模型排序性能稳定，神谕间隙较小；最显著的时间漂移信号是流行度与概率尺度不匹配问题，该问题可通过仅含截距项的诊断性重校准大幅缓解，但基于现有公开数据无法定位该漂移的根本成因。阳性对照仅对幅度较大的注入漂移产生响应，无法排除更细微的漂移存在的可能。本文提出的诊断模式与治理行动的映射关系属于概念性指引，尚未经过有效性验证。

title: A Decision-Support Audit Protocol for Supervision Drift in Proxy-Labeled Credit-Risk Prediction
authors: Mehrdad Shoeibi, Muhammad Shabanpour, Waldemar Karwowski, Niloofar Yousefi
abstract: Credit-risk models are trained on proxy labels and deployed under temporal and segment change, yet no single transfer metric separates base-rate shift, probability-scale shift, and feature-label relationship change. We contribute a design-science artifact: a locked, multi-signal audit protocol for supervision drift in proxy-labeled credit-risk prediction. Five layers (transfer performance, an oracle-gap probe, a calibration diagnostic, feature-label stability, and a synthetic positive control), thresholds, and decision rules were locked before interpretation; a bounded reading is a designed outcome. On a public LendingClub dataset (temporal 2013 to 2016 and cross-segment transfer), ranking is stable and oracle gaps are small; the clearest temporal signal is a prevalence and probability-scale mismatch that intercept-only diagnostic recalibration largely reduces, though its cause is not identifiable from the available release. The positive control responds only to larger injected shifts; subtler drift cannot be excluded. Mapping diagnostic patterns to governance actions is conceptual guidance, not validated here.

title: Universal Defenses for Tool-Integrated LLM Agents Against Adversarial Attacks
title_zh: 面向工具集成大语言模型智能体的通用对抗攻击防御方法
authors: Xiaoyan Li, Yunli Wang
abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated impressive capabilities across a variety of domains, particularly when integrated with external tools for multi-step task completion. However, they are increasingly vulnerable to adversarial attacks, including direct prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, memory poisoning, and backdoor attacks, which exploit the model's openness to prompt injection and tool manipulation. In this work, we explore practical and generalizable defense strategies within a unified framework across these four attack types. We introduce two universal tool-based defenses: Attacker Tool Filtering, which uses anomaly detection (e.g., Isolation Forest) to identify and remove suspicious tools, and Normal Tool Recalling, a white-box method that restores the agent's original toolset prior to planning. Additionally, we incorporate prompt-based defenses: Chain-of-Thought prompting and self-reflection techniques to enhance reasoning and task paraphrasing to mitigate attacks. Experimental results across both four open-source LLMs (Gemma2-9B, Qwen2-7B, LLaMA3-8B, and LLaMA3.1-8B) and three proprietary LLMs (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, and GPT-5) show that our methods significantly reduce the Attack Success Rates (ASR), achieving 0% ASR in many settings, while preserving or even improving the original task success rate. These findings highlight the promise of simple, modular, multi-layered defenses for strengthening the security and robustness of tool-integrated LLM agents. The code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在各类场景下均展现出优异性能，尤其是对接外部工具完成多步任务的能力十分突出。但这类智能体也面临日益严峻的对抗攻击风险，包括直接提示注入、间接提示注入、记忆投毒与后门攻击，攻击者可利用模型对提示注入、工具操作的开放性发起攻击。本研究针对上述四类攻击，在统一框架下探索了实用且具备泛化性的防御策略。本文提出两类基于工具的通用防御方法：攻击者工具过滤，采用孤立森林等异常检测算法识别并移除可疑工具；正常工具召回，这是一种白盒方法，可在智能体启动规划流程前恢复其原始工具集。此外本研究还引入了基于提示的防御手段：思维链提示与自我反思技术，用于增强推理能力、对任务进行复述以缓解攻击影响。在4款开源大语言模型（Gemma2-9B、Qwen2-7B、LLaMA3-8B、LLaMA3.1-8B）与3款闭源大语言模型（GPT-3.5、GPT-4、GPT-5）上开展的实验结果表明，本文提出的方法可大幅降低攻击成功率（ASR），在多数场景下攻击成功率降至0%，同时还能维持甚至提升原始任务的完成成功率。研究结果表明，这类轻量化、模块化的多层级防御方案可有效提升工具集成大语言模型智能体的安全性与鲁棒性。相关代码已发布在指定公开链接。

title: Coaching Qwen3 Coder 30B to Think Like a CodeClash Arena Agent
title_zh: 引导Qwen3 Coder 30B像CodeClash竞技场智能体一样思考
authors: Ivy Ning Zhang
abstract: Large language model coding agents have recently become useful for software tasks, but weaker or open-weight agents still struggle to reliably interpret user intent and execute complex multi-step workflows. This gap is especially visible in long-horizon settings, where an agent must repeatedly inspect prior outcomes, diagnose failure, and choose the next code edit under interaction constraints. It motivates a natural question: what can we do to improve the thinking process of a weak code agent? We study this question in CodeClash, a code-arena benchmark where the original work evaluates 8 commercial coding agents across 6 arenas through multi-round tournaments. Since Qwen3 Coder Plus ranks last among them, we take the open-weight Qwen3-Coder-30B as a case study and investigate how to improve it with distilled knowledge from stronger agents. Our analysis shows that Qwen3-Coder-30B is not well optimized for arena-style interaction: it frequently produces syntax and protocol-breaking errors and exhibits weak strategic adaptation across rounds. These failures are difficult to correct with vanilla instruction tuning alone, since offline SFT cannot directly verify whether a generated action is valid or beneficial. To address this, we propose ReAct SFT, which rewrites teacher trajectories into explicit [obs][thought][act] chains, and trajectoryquality weighted SFT, which reweights samples to encourage post-edit checking. ReAct SFT substantially improves strategic behavior, and our fine-tuned model outperforms the original Qwen3 Coder Plus in tournament evaluation.
summary_zh: 大语言模型代码智能体近年来已可有效支撑各类软件开发任务，但性能较弱或开源权重的代码智能体仍难以可靠理解用户意图、执行复杂多步工作流。这一缺陷在长周期场景下尤为突出：这类场景要求智能体在交互约束下反复检查历史输出、诊断错误、选择下一步代码修改方案。这一现状引出了一个值得研究的问题：如何优化性能不足的代码智能体的思考过程？本研究在CodeClash代码竞技场基准上开展相关探索，该基准的原始工作通过多轮锦标赛对6款商用代码智能体在6个竞技场场景下的性能进行了评估。由于Qwen3 Coder Plus在所有商用智能体中排名垫底，研究团队选取开源权重模型Qwen3-Coder-30B作为研究案例，探索如何通过蒸馏更强智能体的知识提升其性能。分析结果表明，Qwen3-Coder-30B并未针对竞技场交互场景做优化：该模型频繁生成存在语法错误、违反交互协议的输出，多轮交互下的策略适配能力很差。仅采用普通指令微调难以修正这类缺陷，因为离线监督微调（SFT）无法直接验证生成动作是否有效、是否能带来正向收益。针对这一问题，本文提出ReAct监督微调方法，将教师智能体的轨迹改写为显式的[观测][思考][行动]链式结构，同时提出轨迹质量加权监督微调方法，对样本进行重加权以鼓励模型开展修改后校验。ReAct监督微调可大幅提升模型的策略行为表现，经过本文方法微调后的模型在锦标赛评估中的表现超过了原始Qwen3 Coder Plus。

title: RAG-CT: Mitigating Privacy Risks on Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems via Scanning Prompt Distribution
title_zh: RAG-CT：基于提示分布扫描缓解检索增强生成系统隐私风险的方法
authors: Xingyu Lyu, Jiayimei Wang, Jianfeng He, Ning Wang, Yidan Hu 等 (6 人)
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving the quality of generated contents of Large Language Models (LLMs) by grounding responses in external knowledge, thus reducing hallucinations and factual errors. However, recent studies have highlighted a critical vulnerability: adversaries can exploit the retrieval process to extract personally identifiable information (PII) from the underlying corpus. To mitigate this risk, we propose a novel defense, RAG-CT, that identifies malicious queries by analyzing their entropy and margin distributions and using a score-based detection method. Extensive experiments with four state-of-the-art attack strategies and four defense baselines on two datasets show that our approach significantly reduces PII leakage while outperforming existing defenses. This work provides a lightweight yet effective mechanism to protect RAG systems against PII leakage without requiring modifications to the underlying LLM or retriever.
summary_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）是一种可大幅提升大语言模型生成内容质量的主流技术框架，该技术通过将生成回复锚定在外部知识库中，有效减少模型幻觉与事实错误。但近期研究发现该技术存在严重安全漏洞：攻击者可利用检索过程从底层语料库中提取个人可识别信息（PII）。针对这一风险，本文提出了一种全新的防御方案RAG-CT，该方法通过分析查询的熵分布与边际分布，采用基于得分的检测方法识别恶意查询。在两个数据集上针对4种当前最优攻击策略、4种基线防御方法开展的大量实验结果表明，本文提出的方法可大幅降低个人可识别信息泄露风险，性能优于现有防御方案。该技术是一种轻量高效的防护机制，无需修改底层大语言模型或检索器即可为检索增强生成系统提供个人可识别信息泄露防护能力。

title: MUUNRiver-Bench: Diagnosing Relation-Dependent Music Retrieval with Multimodal Instructions
title_zh: MUUNRiver-Bench：面向关系依赖型音乐检索的多模态指令诊断基准
authors: Zhancheng Guo, Congren Dai, Shangda Wu, Jianhuai Hu, Danni Zhao 等 (7 人)
abstract: Music retrieval is relation-dependent: given a reference track, a listener may seek its style with a new theme, a cover, or a comparable voice, and these intents demand contradictory rankings. We present MUUNRiver-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark whose reference-audio queries use natural-language instructions to define relevance. A pipeline combining expert genre priors, LLM-generated prompts and lyrics, synthesis, and expert review yields 3,440 tracks spanning 13 genres and 116 sub-genres, and seven tasks: similar-music, style-preserving lyric-rewriting, lyric-preserving style-rewriting, cover, vocal-timbre, isolated-vocal, and segment retrieval. Across six models in eight configurations, task-wise rank reversals reveal complementary biases: acoustic encoders favour local identity, whereas text-aligned encoders favour semantic relations. Frozen encoders diagnose default similarity preferences; instruction-aware and audio-text fusion systems provide exploratory tests of textual conditioning, with neither simple fusion scheme consistently improving its backbone
summary_zh: 音乐检索具备关系依赖特性：给定一首参考曲目，听众可能想要寻找保留其风格的新主题作品、翻唱版本或音色相近的曲目，这类检索意图对应的排序结果往往存在矛盾。本文提出MUUNRiver-Bench诊断基准，其参考音频查询采用自然语言指令定义相关性。该基准通过融合专家流派先验、大语言模型生成提示词与歌词、音频合成及专家审核的流水线，构建了覆盖13个流派、116个子流派的3440首曲目，包含7项任务：相似音乐检索、保留风格的歌词改写、保留歌词的风格改写、翻唱检索、人声音色检索、分离人声检索及片段检索。在6类模型的8种配置下开展测试，任务维度的排序反转现象揭示了不同模型的互补偏差：音频编码器更偏好局部身份特征，而文本对齐编码器更偏好语义关系。冻结编码器可用于诊断模型默认的相似性偏好；具备指令感知能力与音文融合能力的系统可用于文本条件作用的探索性测试，目前尚无简单融合方案能够持续超越其骨干模型性能。

title: Pseudo-Label Augmentation for Affect Sensing in Small Collaborative Groups
title_zh: 面向小型协作群体情感感知的伪标签增强方法
authors: Meisam Jamshidi Seikavandi, Tanya Ignatenko, Fabricio Batista Narcizo, Paolo Burelli, Jesper Bünsow Boldt 等 (6 人)
abstract: Physiological affect sensing in naturalistic group interaction is often limited by sparse labels rather than sensor data: wearable devices produce many time windows, while self-reports are collected only a few times per session. Using GroupAffect-4, a four-person collaborative dataset with wearable physiology, eye tracking, Big Five personality, and post-task VAD labels, we study pseudo-label augmentation for affect sensing under sparse supervision. We compare no augmentation, Gaussian Process pseudo-labelling, personality-aware trust weighting, and joint personality-plus-confidence weighting within a shared target-construction pipeline. Results show that pseudo-label augmentation improves over the labelled-only baseline in the known-team setting. However, the narrow range of Big Five cosine similarities (0.91-0.99) makes fine-grained personality weighting ineffective; personality similarity functions mainly as a same-team filter rather than a calibrated trust signal. With smoothing, augmented SVM variants are effectively tied on Valence and Arousal, while the joint personality-plus-confidence variant gives the highest Dominance score. Cross-subject LOSO transfer remains encouraging, especially for Arousal, whereas strict session-isolated LOGO removes the augmentation benefit. Given only 10 groups, LOGO should be interpreted as a conservative lower bound on unseen-group transfer. Overall, the results suggest that pseudo-label augmentation can make better use of sparsely labelled collaborative affect data, while personality information is most useful as a within-team selection mechanism.
summary_zh: 自然场景群体交互下的生理情感感知往往受限于稀疏标签而非传感器数据：可穿戴设备可生成大量时间窗口数据，但每轮实验仅能采集少量自我报告标签。本文采用GroupAffect-4数据集（包含4人协作场景下的可穿戴生理数据、眼动数据、大五人格数据及任务后效价-唤醒-支配度（VAD）标签），研究稀疏监督下情感感知任务的伪标签增强方法。在统一的目标构建流水线中，本文对比了无增强、高斯过程伪标签、人格感知信任加权、人格+置信度联合加权四类方案。结果表明，在已知团队场景下，伪标签增强的性能优于仅使用标注数据的基线方法。但大五人格余弦相似度的取值范围较窄（0.91-0.99），导致细粒度人格加权效果不佳；人格相似度主要起到同团队筛选的作用，无法作为校准后的信任信号。加入平滑处理后，增强后的支持向量机变体在效价和唤醒任务上的性能基本持平，而人格+置信度联合加权变体在支配度任务上取得最高得分。跨被试留一法（LOSO）迁移结果表现良好，尤其在唤醒任务上性能突出，但严格的会话隔离留组法（LOGO）会抵消伪标签增强的收益。当仅包含10个团队数据时，LOGO可作为未见团队迁移性能的保守下界。总体而言，伪标签增强可更好地利用标注稀疏的协作情感数据，而人格信息最适合作为团队内部的选择机制。

title: The Imitation Game: When LLMs Learn to Reason Like Programs via Code-Centric Reasoning Data Synthesis
title_zh: 模仿游戏：大语言模型通过以代码为中心的推理数据合成实现类程序推理
authors: Jinyang Zhang, Weibin Liao, Keqin Bao, Sihang Li, Shaobo Wang 等 (13 人)
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at programming tasks but frequently fail at deterministic, fine-grained reasoning in natural language, relying heavily on semantic approximations rather than robust symbolic execution. To bridge this gap, we propose MIMIC, a framework that leverages executable code as a rigorous medium for reasoning data synthesis. MIMIC fundamentally transforms algorithms into verifiable reasoning trajectories through narrative fusion, code-guided test synthesis, and dynamic code instrumentation. Crucially, these explicit intermediate execution states naturally form a Code-Instrumented Reward (CIR), providing dense, high-fidelity process supervision for reinforcement learning without external reward models. Extensive evaluations reveal that models trained via SFT and GRPO on our synthesized dataset achieve substantial, consistent gains. Our method significantly elevates accuracy across general reasoning, complex mathematical benchmarks, and fine-grained deterministic tasks, demonstrating that the procedural rigor of executable code can effectively unlock and enhance the generalized reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Our code and data are available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在编程任务上表现优异，但在自然语言场景下的确定性细粒度推理中经常失效，严重依赖语义近似而非鲁棒的符号执行。为解决这一问题，本文提出MIMIC框架，将可执行代码作为推理数据合成的严谨载体。MIMIC通过叙事融合、代码引导的测试合成与动态代码插桩，将算法转化为可验证的推理轨迹。核心创新点在于，这些显式的中间执行状态可自然形成代码插桩奖励（Code-Instrumented Reward, CIR），无需外部奖励模型即可为强化学习提供密集、高保真的过程监督。大量实验表明，在本文合成数据集上通过监督微调（SFT）和广义相对策略优化（GRPO）训练的模型性能获得了持续且显著的提升。该方法大幅提升了通用推理、复杂数学基准测试及细粒度确定性任务的准确率，证明可执行代码的过程严谨性能够有效释放并增强大语言模型的通用推理能力。本文的代码和数据已公开在指定链接。

title: The Immutable Past: Formalizing State Mutability and Conflict Resolution in Mutable RAG
title_zh: 不可变过去：可变检索增强生成（Mutable RAG）中的状态可变性与冲突消解形式化定义
authors: Hamed HaddadPajouh, Amir AmiriTabat
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) serves as the primary memory architecture for long-horizon autonomous agents. However, treating shared memory as an append-only stream introduces \textit{Semantic Shadowing}, a critical failure mode where conflicting historical observations accumulate and statistically dominate valid recent updates. In dynamic environments, this results in severe state divergence as agents retrieve and act upon obsolete facts. This paper formalizes the mechanics of State Mutability to prove that standard dense retrieval suffers from Asymptotic Recall Decay. Furthermore, we formally demonstrate a Majority Vote Trap, revealing that increasing the retrieval context window paradoxically degrades generation accuracy by diluting the attention mechanism under conditions of semantic equivalence. To resolve this, we introduce GC-Mem (Garbage Collection for Memory), a strict inference-time consistency protocol. Unlike heuristic time-decay mechanisms---which indiscriminately destroy valid long-term memory---GC-Mem relies purely on a temporal dominance operator ($\Phi_{\mathcal{T}}$) paired with contradiction detection to surgically excise shadowed context. Evaluated across a rigorous, behaviorally inferred benchmark of 137,760 memory chunks and continuous accumulation sweeps, standard RAG and timestamp re-ranking baselines experience severe degradation. In contrast, GC-Mem empirically recovers $>90\%$ conflict resolution accuracy. We establish strict precision and recall deployment thresholds, ensuring state convergence where standard mutable RAG fundamentally fails.
summary_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）是长 horizon 自主智能体的核心内存架构。但将共享内存视为仅支持追加的流会引发「语义遮蔽」这一关键失效模式：冲突的历史观测值不断累积，在统计层面压倒有效的近期更新。在动态环境中，智能体检索过时事实并据此行动，会引发严重的状态偏差。本文对状态可变性的机制进行形式化定义，证明标准的稠密检索存在渐近召回衰减问题。此外，本文正式提出「多数投票陷阱」现象：在语义等价条件下，扩大检索上下文窗口会稀释注意力机制，反而降低生成准确率。为解决上述问题，本文提出GC-Mem（内存垃圾回收），一种严格的推理时一致性协议。不同于无差别破坏有效长期记忆的启发式时间衰减机制，GC-Mem仅依赖时间优势算子（Φ_𝒯）与冲突检测，精准切除被遮蔽的上下文。在包含137760个内存块的行为推断基准及连续累积扫描测试中，标准RAG与时间戳重排序基线的性能出现严重下降，而GC-Mem的冲突消解准确率超过90%。本文还设定了严格的精确率与召回率部署阈值，可在标准可变RAG完全失效的场景下实现状态收敛。

title: Schema-Adaptive Action-Conditioned JEPA for Cross-Machine CNC Transfer under Partial Sensor Overlap
title_zh: 面向部分传感器重叠下跨机床CNC迁移的模式自适应动作条件JEPA架构
authors: Ayoub Louaye Bouaziz, Matthieu Ostertag, Anton Demasles
abstract: Cross-machine deployment of industrial world models requires transfer across changes in dynamics, sensing interfaces, sampling regimes, and control units. We study a schema-adaptive action-conditioned Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (SAAC-JEPA) for CNC dynamics, where the source machine has 17 canonical sensor channels and the target shares only 10. Evaluation uses group-disjoint source splits, source-only normalization, held-out self-supervised validation, unit audits, and a sealed target test after model locking. Across five seeds, JEPA pretraining gives no clean-source forecasting gain: scratch and pretrained-body models obtain \(\mathrm{RMSE}=0.811\pm0.022\) and \(0.813\pm0.022\). A source-only search over 20 candidates selects a schema-consistent action-conditioned JEPA after seven-seed stability checks. On the confirmatory target pass, the locked model reaches zero-shot \(\mathrm{RMSE}=0.546\), \(R^2=0.012\), and \(\mathrm{NLL}=0.52\), outperforming persistence but not RevIN-equipped PatchTST and iTransformer baselines (\(0.503\) and \(0.498\)). A pre-declared paired ablation shows that RevIN in the same architecture improves RMSE to \(0.495\pm0.004\) over three seeds, but degrades target calibration (\(\mathrm{NLL}=20.6\)) on stationary context windows. A pre-lock adaptation sweep further reduces RMSE to \(0.520\) with limited target support. These results show that source-domain forecasting accuracy alone is insufficient to assess industrial predictive representations, and that cross-machine adaptation under partial sensor overlap is a distinct evaluation axis.
summary_zh: 工业世界模型的跨机床部署需要适应动力学特性、传感接口、采样机制与控制单元的变化。本文研究面向CNC动力学预测的模式自适应动作条件联合嵌入预测架构（SAAC-JEPA），其中源机床包含17个标准传感器通道，目标机床仅共享其中10个通道。评估方案采用组不相交的源数据集划分、仅基于源数据的归一化、预留自监督验证集、单元审计，以及模型锁定后的密封目标测试集。在5次随机种子测试下，仅使用JEPA预训练未在源数据预测任务上获得明显增益：从零训练模型与预训练骨干模型的均方根误差（RMSE）分别为0.811±0.022与0.813±0.022。在源域对20个候选架构进行搜索，经过7次种子稳定性校验后选出符合模式一致性的动作条件JEPA模型。在目标机的验证测试中，锁定后的模型零样本预测RMSE达到0.546，决定系数R²为0.012，负对数似然（NLL）为0.52，性能优于持久性基线，但低于搭载RevIN的PatchTST与iTransformer基线（RMSE分别为0.503和0.498）。预先设计的配对消融实验表明，在同一架构中加入RevIN可在3次种子测试下将RMSE提升至0.495±0.004，但会导致平稳上下文窗口下的目标校准性能下降（NLL=20.6）。在有限目标数据支持下开展预锁定自适应扫描，可进一步将RMSE降至0.520。上述结果表明，仅靠源域预测准确率不足以评估工业预测表征的性能，部分传感器重叠场景下的跨机床自适应是一个独立的评估维度。

title: Efficient Multimodal Generative Recommendation with Latent Narrative Reasoning
title_zh: 结合隐式叙事推理的高效多模态生成式推荐
authors: Chenxing Wang, Nantao Zheng, Hao Miao, Juyuan Wang, Xinke Jiang 等 (8 人)
abstract: Generative recommendation reformulates item prediction as semantic identifier generation, yet episodic content introduces a fundamentally different setting where the target is determined by narrative evolution rather than user preference. This task requires models to understand multimodal storyline progression while addressing the efficiency challenges caused by redundant visual contexts and costly explicit reasoning generation. We propose \textbf{NarraLite}, an efficient multimodal generative recommendation framework that jointly compresses perception and reasoning. Specifically, Progressive Spectral Compression selectively distills long visual contexts into compact narrative-relevant evidence, preserving transition-critical information while reducing redundant visual computation. Latent Narrative Reasoning introduces context-routed latent reasoning tokens and aligns their contextualized representations with future continuation semantics, enabling implicit narrative inference without autoregressively decoding textual rationales. We further establish a user-agnostic multimodal benchmark for short-form drama continuation across UGC, PGC, and OOD settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NarraLite consistently improves continuation accuracy, narrative coherence, and robustness over existing approaches, while achieving a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off.
summary_zh: 生成式推荐将物品预测重构为语义标识符生成任务，但情节类内容场景存在本质差异：推荐目标由叙事演化决定，而非用户偏好。该任务要求模型理解多模态剧情的演进逻辑，同时应对冗余视觉上下文与显式推理生成成本过高带来的效率挑战。本文提出NarraLite，一种高效多模态生成式推荐框架，可同时实现感知与推理的联合压缩。具体而言，渐进式光谱压缩技术可将长视觉上下文选择性蒸馏为与叙事相关的紧凑证据，在保留关键转换信息的同时减少冗余视觉计算。隐式叙事推理技术引入上下文路由的隐式推理令牌，将其上下文表征与后续内容语义对齐，无需自回归解码文本理由即可实现隐式叙事推断。本文还构建了面向短视频剧情续写的用户无关多模态基准，覆盖用户生成内容（UGC）、专业生成内容（PGC）与分布外（OOD）三类场景。大量实验表明，相较于现有方法，NarraLite可持续提升剧情续写准确率、叙事连贯性与鲁棒性，同时实现了更优的准确率-效率权衡。

title: Beyond Distribution Matching: Semantics-Consistent Tabular Diffusion with Weak Semantic Priors
title_zh: 超越分布匹配：基于弱语义先验的语义一致表格扩散模型
authors: Yili Wang, Ruxue Shi, Mengnan Du, Hangting Ye, Yi Chang 等 (6 人)
abstract: Synthetic tabular data can match real data distributions while still violating the semantic constraints that govern valid tabular rows. This reveals a key limitation of existing tabular generators: they mainly optimize distributional fidelity, but do not explicitly model weak semantic priors encoded in tabular schema and textual descriptions. In this paper, we propose \ours, a semantics-consistent tabular diffusion framework for high-fidelity synthetic data generation under weakly specified semantic priors. \ours\ first constructs two types of priors, namely intra-column semantics and inter-column symbolic rules, with LLM-assisted extraction from metadata and validation on the real training split. These priors are then used as generation conditions rather than post-hoc filters. Specifically, \ours\ maps heterogeneous column values, column identities, and semantic priors into a unified semantic space, and performs column-wise forward corruption and prior-conditioned reverse denoising to preserve both marginal distributions and rule-consistent cross-column dependencies. Extensive experiments on six real-world tabular benchmarks show that \ours\ consistently improves distributional fidelity, semantic consistency, and downstream task utility over representative VAE-, GAN-, LLM-, and diffusion-based baselines. Additional analyses further demonstrate the robustness of \ours\ when semantic priors are partially unavailable.
summary_zh: 合成表格数据在匹配真实数据分布的同时，仍可能违反约束有效表格行的语义规则。这暴露了现有表格生成模型的核心缺陷：这类模型主要优化分布保真度，未对表格模式与文本描述中编码的弱语义先验进行显式建模。本文提出语义一致表格扩散框架，可在弱语义先验的约束下生成高保真合成数据。该框架首先通过大语言模型从元数据中辅助提取两类先验：列内语义规则与列间符号规则，并在真实训练集划分上完成验证。这些先验将作为生成条件而非事后过滤规则使用。具体而言，该框架将异质列值、列标识与语义先验映射到统一语义空间，执行列维度的前向加噪与先验条件反向去噪，同时保留边缘分布与符合规则的跨列依赖关系。在6个真实世界表格基准上的大量实验表明，相较于基于VAE、GAN、大语言模型及扩散模型的代表性基线方法，该框架在分布保真度、语义一致性与下游任务效用上均获得持续提升。额外分析还表明，当部分语义先验不可用时，该框架仍具备良好鲁棒性。

title: You Don't Need To Train: Agentic Heuristic Learning Studio for Executable Human Activity Recognition
title_zh: 无需训练：面向可执行人类活动识别的智能体启发式学习工作室
authors: Siyu Yuan, He Zhang, Sizhen Bian, Bin Guo
abstract: Human activity recognition (HAR) is usually framed as gradient-based training of neural networks. Agentic Heuristic Learning (AHL) Studio explores a complementary view inspired by human cognitive learning: people learn activities by remembering examples, forming rules, and repairing mistakes, not by backpropagating. This proposed tool implements AHL for HAR: a learning-time agent reasons over sensor protocols, proposes executable heuristic policies, records repair traces, and exports an LLM-free policy for edge deployment. We focus on the HAR benchmark family and provide an end-to-end workflow from dataset observation to edge-oriented export. On eleven HAR datasets evaluated so far, AHL policies reach strong executable-policy performance while remaining inspectable, editable, and replayable \footnote{this https URL}.
summary_zh: 人类活动识别（HAR）通常被定义为基于梯度的神经网络训练任务。智能体启发式学习（Agentic Heuristic Learning, AHL）工作室提出了一种受人类认知学习启发的互补思路：人类通过记忆示例、形成规则、修正错误来学习活动，而非通过反向传播。本文提出的工具将AHL落地到人类活动识别场景：学习阶段的智能体基于传感器协议进行推理，提出可执行的启发式策略，记录修正轨迹，最终导出无需大语言模型的策略用于边缘端部署。本文面向人类活动识别基准系列提供了从数据集观测到面向边缘部署导出的端到端工作流。在目前已测试的11个人类活动识别数据集上，AHL策略在可执行策略场景下取得了优异性能，同时具备可解释、可编辑、可复现的特性，项目链接已公开。

title: POSPAN: Position-Constrained Span Masking for Language Model Pre-training
title_zh: POSPAN：面向语言模型预训练的位置约束跨度掩码方法
authors: Zhenyu Zhang, Lei Shen, Yuming Zhao, Meng Chen, Xiaodong He
abstract: Span-level masked language modeling (MLM) has shown to be advantageous to pre-trained language models over the original single-token MLM, as entities/phrases and their dependencies are critical to language understanding. Previous works only consider span length with some discrete distributions, while the dependencies among spans are ignored, i.e., assuming that the positions of masked spans are uniformly distributed. In this paper, we present POSPAN, a general framework to allow diverse position-constrained span masking strategies via the combination of span length distribution and position constraint distribution, which unifies all existing span-level masking methods. To verify the effectiveness of POSPAN in pre-training, we evaluate it on the datasets from several NLU benchmarks. Experimental results indicate that the position constraint is capable of enhancing span-level masking broadly, and our best POSPAN setting consistently outperforms its span-length-only counterparts and vanilla MLM. We also conduct theoretical analysis for the position constraint in masked language models to shed light on the reason why POSPAN works well, demonstrating the rationality and necessity of POSPAN.
summary_zh: 相较于原始的单令牌掩码语言建模（MLM），跨度级掩码语言建模在预训练语言模型上表现出显著优势，因为实体/短语及其依赖关系对语言理解至关重要。现有工作仅基于离散分布考虑跨度长度，忽略了跨度之间的依赖关系，即假设掩码跨度的位置服从均匀分布。本文提出POSPAN通用框架，通过融合跨度长度分布与位置约束分布，实现多种位置约束跨度掩码策略，统一了所有现有跨度级掩码方法。为验证POSPAN在预训练中的有效性，本文在多个自然语言理解（NLU）基准数据集上开展评估。实验结果表明，位置约束可广泛提升跨度级掩码的性能，最优配置下的POSPAN持续优于仅考虑跨度长度的基线方法与原始掩码语言建模方法。本文还针对掩码语言模型中的位置约束开展理论分析，揭示POSPAN性能优异的底层原因，证明了该方法的合理性与必要性。

title: HintMiner: Automatic Question Hints Mining From Q&A Web Posts with Language Model via Self-Supervised Learning
title_zh: HintMiner：基于自监督学习与大语言模型的问答网页自动问题提示挖掘工具
authors: Zhenyu Zhang, JiuDong Yang
abstract: Users often need ask questions and seek answers online. The Question - Answering (QA) forums such as Stack Overflow cannot always respond to the questions timely and properly. In this paper, we propose HintMiner, a novel automatic question hints mining tool for users to help them find answers. HintMiner leverages the machine comprehension and sequence generation techniques to automatically generate hints for users' questions. It firstly retrieve many web Q\&A posts and then extract some hints from the posts using MiningNet that is built via a language model. Using the huge amount of online Q\&A posts, we design a self-supervised objective to train the MiningNet that is a neural encoder-decoder model based on the transformer and copying mechanisms. We have evaluated HintMiner on 60,000 Stack Overflow questions. The experiment results show that the proposed approach is effective. For example, HintMiner achieves an average BLEU score of 36.17\% and an average ROUGE-2 score of 36.29\%. Our tool and experimental data are publicly available.
summary_zh: 用户经常需要在线提问并寻求答案，但Stack Overflow等问答论坛往往无法及时准确地响应问题。本文提出HintMiner，一种新型自动问题提示挖掘工具，可帮助用户快速找到答案。HintMiner利用机器理解与序列生成技术自动为用户问题生成提示：首先检索大量网页问答帖子，然后通过基于大语言模型构建的MiningNet从帖子中提取提示内容。本文利用海量在线问答帖子设计自监督目标，训练基于Transformer与复制机制的编解码神经网络MiningNet。在6万条Stack Overflow问题上开展评估，实验结果表明该方法性能优异：HintMiner的平均BLEU值达到36.17%，平均ROUGE-2值达到36.29%。本文的工具与实验数据已公开。

title: Driver Behavior Estimation at Signalized Intersections Using a Physics-Constrained Decision-Conditioned Autoregressive Transformer
title_zh: 基于物理约束决策条件自回归Transformer的信号交叉口驾驶员行为估计
authors: Mohammad Khoshkdahan, Pavel Laskov, Alexey Vinel
abstract: Red-light violations and harsh braking at signalized intersections are major contributors to traffic accidents. This paper analyzes and predicts human driver decision-making and longitudinal trajectory behavior during traffic light signal transitions. We collected a diverse real-world dataset comprising 449 approach runs under varying speed and distance conditions. Vehicle motion was recorded using RTK-corrected GNSS with centimeter-level accuracy, and driver heart rate and multi-level comfort ratings were monitored. Spatial and temporal calibration ensured precise alignment between vehicle state and signal timing. Statistical analysis identifies required deceleration as the dominant single predictor of the stop-go decision, and heteroscedastic Gaussian modeling of peak deceleration reveals five empirical comfort ranges derived from human stopping behavior. Based on this insight, we propose a two-stage modeling framework. Stage 1 predicts the binary maneuver decision, and Stage 2 generates the longitudinal acceleration trajectory using a decision-conditioned autoregressive Transformer with physics constraints, including target-state conditioning and jerk limits. The proposed architecture outperforms baseline methods and achieves 0.49m/s^2 acceleration MAE and 0.62m distance MAE. It also estimates the future stopping-comfort level of the human driver from a single yellow-onset snapshot. Qualitative results demonstrate realistic human-like braking behavior. The dataset and source code are publicly available.
summary_zh: 信号交叉口的闯红灯行为与急减速行为是引发交通事故的主要诱因。本文针对信号灯切换过程中人类驾驶员的决策行为与纵向轨迹行为展开分析与预测。研究采集了覆盖不同车速、不同车距场景的449次车辆驶入交叉口过程的多样化真实世界数据集：采用厘米级精度的RTK（实时动态差分）校正GNSS（全球导航卫星系统）记录车辆运动状态，同时监测驾驶员心率与多等级舒适度评分，通过时空校准实现车辆状态与信号灯配时的精准对齐。统计分析结果表明，所需减速度是决定驾驶员停车/通行决策的最核心单一预测因子，基于异方差高斯模型对峰值减速度的建模，从人类停车行为中归纳得到5个经验性舒适度区间。基于上述研究结论，本文提出两阶段建模框架：第一阶段预测二元操控决策，第二阶段采用加入物理约束（包含目标状态条件约束、加加速度限值）的决策条件自回归Transformer生成纵向加速度轨迹。所提出的架构性能优于所有基线方法，加速度平均绝对误差达0.49m/s²，距离平均绝对误差达0.62m，仅需黄灯亮起时刻的单帧快照即可预测人类驾驶员未来的停车舒适度等级。定性结果显示该模型输出的制动行为高度贴合真实人类表现。本研究的数据集与源代码已公开。

title: OmniHarness: Harnessing Generalizable Visual Generation via Symbolic Policy Learning
title_zh: OmniHarness：基于符号策略学习实现可泛化视觉生成
authors: Xu Xu, Jinxiu Liu, Zhangbo Qiao, Jiaxing Lu, Xiangyu Zhang 等 (8 人)
abstract: Unified multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and multi-agent systems have advanced visual generation. However, three limitations remain. (1) Existing methods often distill task-specific experience with limited generalizability. (2) Reflection is often deferred until task completion. (3) Knowledge is often acquired only in response to downstream task demands. To address these limitations, we introduce OmniHarness, a framework for generalizable visual generation via symbolic policy learning. OmniHarness abstracts verified executions into symbolic policies for visual generation task families, capturing shared procedures and applicability conditions while removing instance-specific inputs. The harness instantiates, adapts, and composes these policies for new tasks. Intermediate verification guides refinement and failure recovery during execution. Through self-directed inquiry, OmniHarness autonomously generates and executes practice tasks near its capability limits before downstream objectives are specified. Execution feedback continually refines the policies while model parameters remain fixed. Experiments across six benchmarks, three MLLM backbones, and three visual agent frameworks demonstrate strong performance and continual capability expansion. On ComfyBench's Creative tasks, OmniHarness achieves a 95.0% resolve rate, exceeding the strongest baseline by 27.5 percentage points. Frozen policy snapshots improve existing visual agent systems through plug-and-play reuse.
summary_zh: 统一多模态大语言模型（MLLM）与多智能体系统的发展推动了视觉生成领域的进步，但现有方法仍存在三点局限：1）多数方法仅提炼特定任务的经验，泛化能力有限；2）反思环节通常延迟到任务全部完成后才触发；3）知识仅能在下游任务需求的驱动下获取。为解决上述问题，本文提出OmniHarness框架，通过符号策略学习实现可泛化视觉生成。OmniHarness将已验证的执行过程抽象为面向视觉生成任务族的符号策略，在剔除实例专属输入的同时，保留通用流程与适用条件，可针对新任务完成策略的实例化、适配与组合，执行过程中通过中间环节验证引导策略优化与故障恢复。在下游任务目标明确前，OmniHarness可通过自主探究，在自身能力边界附近自主生成并执行练习任务，在模型参数完全固定的前提下，通过执行反馈持续优化符号策略。在6个基准数据集、3种MLLM骨干网络、3类视觉智能体框架上开展的实验证明该框架具备优异性能与持续能力拓展特性：在ComfyBench创意任务中，OmniHarness的任务解决率达95.0%，性能超出最优基线27.5个百分点，生成的冻结策略快照可即插即用，直接提升现有视觉智能体系统的性能。

title: Managing Action Preconditions in Neuro-Symbolic RL: Three Placement Strategies for Embodied Agents
title_zh: 神经符号强化学习中的动作前置条件管理：面向具身智能体的三种部署策略
authors: Norbert Oswald, Fabian Deuser, Thomas Bräunl
abstract: Humans carry behaviour knowledge of how to act in familiar situations into every new task rather than relearning it from scratch. There is no reason a Reinforcement Learning (RL) agent shouldn't do the same: known behaviour patterns need not be learned, only applied. Neuro-symbolic RL bridges prior knowledge and RL by injecting symbolic knowledge alongside a learned policy. The point at which this knowledge is integrated is critical: a poor choice can produce, for instance, hallucinated preconditions, which surface as safety and reliability problems in agents acting in changing environments. We formalise this behavioural knowledge as a precondition Bayesian network (BN) over the agent's \emph{structural actions} - the actions whose legality depends on preconditions, such as picking up a key, grasping a block, toggling a door, or dropping an object. The BN restricts when these actions may fire, and we inject it into the RL loop at three placements: (1) a \emph{symbolic verifier}, consulted only at inference, that fires a structural action once its preconditions hold; (2) a \emph{symbolic enforcer}, active during both training and inference, that governs structural-action use throughout learning; and (3) a \emph{symbolic learner}, which folds the knowledge into the network and learns the restriction and use of structural actions itself. To test the three variants we run experiments on two benchmarks with opposite regimes: one built on long, ordered planning chains, the other on continuous manipulation. We compare against strong baselines on solution quality, sample efficiency, and traceability. The payoff is substantial. On MiniGrid, all three placements improve the \emph{solution quality} over the PPO+RND baseline, the symbolic enforcer leading at $98.2\%$ against the baseline's $88.8\%$. On Fetch, $\dots$
summary_zh: 人类会将熟悉场景下的行为知识迁移到新任务中，无需从零开始重新学习，强化学习（RL）智能体同样可以遵循该逻辑：已知的行为模式无需重复学习，仅需直接应用即可。神经符号强化学习通过在学习到的策略中注入符号知识，打通了先验知识与强化学习的连接通道，而知识注入的节点选择至关重要：不合理的选择会引发前置条件幻觉等问题，导致智能体在动态变化的环境中出现安全隐患与可靠性缺陷。本文将行为知识形式化为作用于智能体结构化动作的前置条件贝叶斯网络（BN），其中结构化动作指合法性依赖前置条件的动作，例如拾取钥匙、抓取积木、开关门、放置物体等。该贝叶斯网络可限制上述动作的触发时机，本文将其以三种不同方式注入强化学习循环：1）符号验证器：仅在推理阶段调用，当结构化动作的前置条件全部满足时才触发该动作；2）符号强制执行器：在训练与推理阶段均处于激活状态，在整个学习过程中管控结构化动作的使用；3）符号学习器：将知识嵌入网络结构，自主学习结构化动作的使用规则与约束。为验证三种方案的效果，本文在两类特性完全相反的基准测试集上开展实验：一类基于长序列有序规划链构建，另一类面向连续操控场景，从解质量、样本效率、可追溯性三个维度与强基线方法开展对比，结果显示三种方案均能带来显著收益：在MiniGrid测试集上，三种部署策略的解质量均优于PPO+RND基线，其中符号强制执行器的性能最优，准确率达98.2%，而基线仅为88.8%。在Fetch测试集上……

title: State of Thought Enables Endogenous Reasoning
title_zh: 思维状态可实现大语言模型的内生推理
authors: Zhiren Gong, Yikun Hou, Zihao Zeng, Ming Xiao, Chau Yuen 等 (6 人)
abstract: Test-time compute has emerged as a major approach to improving the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing test-time reasoning paradigms rely heavily on externally imposed control, either through fixed reasoning programs or through costly expansion in constrained search spaces, limiting both generalization and efficiency. We propose State of Thought (SoT), a new reasoning paradigm that enables endogenous reasoning in LLMs, with the model's internal reasoning state governing how reasoning unfolds. Concretely, SoT extracts a compact dynamics-geometric state from the model's internal information transfer and uses a 582-parameter controller on frozen backbones to selectively activate historical reasoning support useful under the current reasoning state, framing reasoning as a state-conditioned process over evidence rather than an externally prescribed token chain. Across quantitative (1.34x), general (1.62x), symbolic-and-code (1.76x), and long-context (2.51x) reasoning on 3 LLMs and 16 datasets, SoT consistently improves mean-baseline accuracy while reducing generated tokens by 62.6% and end-to-end latency by 44.6%. Across 2 VLM scales and 3 reasoning tasks, it improves mean accuracy by 3.8 points over reasoning baselines, with 74.9% fewer completion tokens and 73.5% lower latency than search-based methods. Under constrained access, SoT retains 38.2%/36.5% mean accuracy gains in training-free/embedding-only settings, while trajectory-only judging reaches 84.1% agreement across 3 API models. Together, endogenous state-driven reasoning provides a generalizable and efficient alternative.
summary_zh: 测试时计算优化是当前提升大语言模型（LLM）能力的主流方法，但现有测试时推理范式高度依赖外部施加的控制，要么采用固定推理程序，要么在受限搜索空间内进行高成本的扩展，同时限制了泛化能力与运行效率。本文提出State of Thought（SoT，思维状态）这一全新推理范式，可实现大语言模型的内生推理，由模型内部的推理状态自主决定推理过程的演进方式。具体而言，SoT从模型内部的信息传递过程中提取紧凑的动力学几何状态，在骨干网络完全冻结的前提下，采用仅含582个参数的控制器，根据当前推理状态选择性激活可提供有效支撑的历史推理信息，将推理过程建模为基于证据的状态条件化流程，而非外部预设的token生成链。在3类大语言模型、16个数据集上开展的测试覆盖通用推理（性能提升1.34倍）、通用场景（性能提升1.62倍）、符号与代码推理（性能提升1.76倍）、长上下文推理（性能提升2.51倍）四类场景，结果显示SoT在平均基线准确率提升的同时，生成token数量减少62.6%，端到端延迟降低44.6%。在2类视觉大模型规模、3类推理任务上，相比基线推理方法平均准确率提升3.8个百分点，相比基于搜索的方法，完成token数量减少74.9%，延迟降低73.5%。在访问受限场景下，无训练/仅可调用嵌入接口的设置中，SoT仍可保留38.2%/36.5%的平均准确率增益，仅基于轨迹的评判方式在3款API模型上的一致性可达84.1%。综上，内生状态驱动的推理为大模型推理提供了一种兼具泛化性与效率的全新可选方案。

title: Causal neural set filtering for online multi-target tracking
title_zh: 面向在线多目标跟踪的因果神经集合滤波
authors: Zhongdi Liu, Huangyu Dai
abstract: Transformer-based multi-target tracking (MTT) jointly learns data association and state estimation, but MT3/Track-MT3-style trackers repeatedly re-encode measurement windows, incurring redundant computation. We propose Causal Neural Set Filtering (CNSF)\footnote{\href{this https URL}{Code:this https URL}}, a neural set filter that encodes only current measurements while carrying past evidence in a structured recursive track state. CNSF combines exclusive Sinkhorn association, association-conditioned Kalman-shaped updates with moment matching, and recurrent Bernoulli lifecycle modeling with measurement-driven birth. These mechanisms impose soft one-to-one constraints, propagate association-induced state uncertainty, and support existence estimation under missed detections and birth--death transitions. On a held-out three-regime simulated test set, CNSF reduces mean GOSPA and T-GOSPA relative to Track-MT3 by 19.3\% and 30.4\%, with 55.9\% fewer parameters and a $3.76\times$ speedup in single-thread CPU inference.
summary_zh: 基于Transformer的多目标跟踪（MTT）方法可联合学习数据关联与状态估计，但MT3/Track-MT3类跟踪器需要对测量窗口进行重复重编码，存在大量冗余计算。本文提出Causal Neural Set Filtering（CNSF，因果神经集合滤波）这一神经集合滤波方法，仅对当前测量值进行编码，将历史证据保存在结构化的递归轨迹状态中。CNSF融合了排他性Sinkhorn关联、基于矩匹配的关联条件化卡尔曼式更新、以及由测量驱动新生的递归伯努利生命周期建模三类机制，可实现软一对一约束、传递关联引发的状态不确定性，支持存在漏检与轨迹生灭切换场景下的目标存在性估计。在包含三类场景的独立模拟测试集上，相比Track-MT3基线，CNSF的平均GOSPA与T-GOSPA指标分别降低19.3%与30.4%，参数量减少55.9%，单线程CPU推理速度提升3.76倍。

title: Retrieval-Driven Memory Reconsolidation for Long-Term LLM Agents
title_zh: 面向大语言模型长期智能体的检索驱动记忆再巩固框架
authors: Yuanyi Song, Yukai Wang, Xinbei Ma, Zhihui Fu, Jianghao Lin 等 (10 人)
abstract: Long-term memory is essential for LLM-based agents operating over extended interactions. Existing memory systems primarily update memory when new information arrives, treating retrieval as the endpoint of memory access rather than a driver of memory evolution. Consequently, retrieval feedback is rarely exploited to reorganize memory for future access continuously. Moreover, most existing approaches rely on predefined memory structures together with fixed retrieval pipelines, limiting the agent's ability to organize and evolve its own memory autonomously. Inspired by memory reconsolidation in cognitive neuroscience, we propose \textbf{REALM}, a \textbf{r}econsolidation-\textbf{e}volution \textbf{a}gentic \textbf{l}ong-term \textbf{m}emory framework. It models long-term memory as a continual lifecycle by autonomously organizing memories into a heterogeneous cognitive graph, retrieving evidence via adaptively composed graph-search atoms, and continually reconsolidating memories based on retrieval feedback. REALM achieves an average accuracy of 75.97\% on LoCoMo and 65.11\% on LongMemEval, outperforming the strongest baselines by 7.17 and 1.31 points respectively. Ablation studies confirm that memory reconsolidation consistently boosts performance, with further analyses revealing that it progressively reorganizes related memory units into more coherent local structures for collective evidence recall and utilization during reasoning. These results suggest that retrieval-driven memory reconsolidation provides an effective mechanism for continually evolving long-term memory in LLM agents.
summary_zh: 长期记忆是支撑大语言模型智能体完成长周期交互任务的核心基础。现有记忆系统大多仅在新信息到达时更新记忆，将检索视为记忆访问的终点而非记忆演化的驱动因素，因此几乎无法利用检索反馈持续重构记忆以优化后续访问效率。此外，多数现有方法依赖预定义的记忆结构与固定检索流水线，限制了智能体自主组织、演化自身记忆的能力。受认知神经科学中记忆再巩固机制的启发，本文提出REALM框架，即再巩固演化型智能体长期记忆框架，将长期记忆建模为持续演进的生命周期：自主将记忆组织为异质认知图，通过自适应组合的图搜索原子检索证据，基于检索反馈持续完成记忆再巩固。REALM在LoCoMo数据集上的平均准确率达75.97%，在LongMemEval数据集上的平均准确率达65.11%，性能分别超出最优基线7.17和1.31个百分点。消融实验验证了记忆再巩固机制可稳定提升模型性能，进一步分析显示该机制可逐步将关联记忆单元重组为更连贯的局部结构，支撑推理过程中对关联证据的召回与利用。上述结果表明，检索驱动的记忆再巩固是实现大语言模型智能体长期记忆持续演化的有效机制。

title: "Looking for Something Weird to Happen": How Humans Sustain AI Agent Novelty Amid Semantic Collapse
title_zh: “期待异常事件发生”：语义坍缩场景下人类维持AI智能体输出新颖性的机制研究
authors: Shiyang Lai, Arna Woemmel, Hongkai Mao, Junsol Kim, Summer Eunhyung Ann 等 (6 人)
abstract: Semantic collapse, the progressive narrowing of what AI systems generate, has been studied mainly in closed settings, and remedies have targeted models and data. We study it in MOLTBOOK, a social network of interacting AI agents that human users configure and steer. Across 30,076 active agents, output grows less diverse within agents and more similar across them over weeks, yet a minority sustains high novelty. Interviews with users of high- and typical-novelty agents (N=11) associate sustained novelty with three features: users value novelty of itself, they supply broad and distinctive material and revise it when output narrows, and they approach MOLTBOOK as a new agentic world to explore, not a venue to instrumentally exploit. A survey of users of distinctive agents (N=53) confirms these patterns. Communities with more novel agents also show more diverse output from other agents. We discuss interface and policy interventions that could support improved human input.
summary_zh: 语义坍缩指AI系统生成内容的多样性逐步收窄的现象，现有相关研究大多在封闭场景下开展，对应的优化方案也主要针对模型与数据本身。本文在MOLTBOOK这一由人类用户配置、管控的交互AI智能体社交网络中开展语义坍缩研究，对30076个活跃智能体的长期运行数据统计发现：数周内单个智能体的输出多样性逐步降低，不同智能体之间的输出相似度逐步提升，但仍有少数智能体可长期保持高输出新颖性。针对高新颖性智能体与普通新颖性智能体的11名用户开展的访谈结果显示，长期维持高新颖性与三类用户特征相关：用户本身重视输出新颖性、主动提供广泛且有辨识度的输入素材并在输出多样性收窄时及时调整、将MOLTBOOK视为可探索的全新智能体世界而非仅作为工具使用。针对53名高辨识度智能体用户开展的问卷调查进一步验证了上述规律，拥有更多高新颖性智能体的社区中，其余智能体的输出多样性也更高。本文最后讨论了可优化人类输入质量的界面与政策干预方案。

title: SemanticAdv: Generating Adversarial Examples via Attribute-conditional Image Editing
title_zh: SemanticAdv：基于属性条件图像编辑生成对抗样本
authors: Haonan Qiu, Chaowei Xiao, Lei Yang, Xinchen Yan, Honglak Lee 等 (6 人)
abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have achieved great success in various applications due to their strong expressive power. However, recent studies have shown that DNNs are vulnerable to adversarial examples which are manipulated instances targeting to mislead DNNs to make incorrect predictions. Currently, most such adversarial examples try to guarantee "subtle perturbation" by limiting the $L_p$ norm of the perturbation. In this paper, we aim to explore the impact of semantic manipulation on DNNs predictions by manipulating the semantic attributes of images and generate "unrestricted adversarial examples".In particular, we propose an algorithm \emph{SemanticAdv} which leverages disentangled semantic factors to generate adversarial perturbation by altering controlled semantic attributes to fool the learner towards various "adversarial" targets. We conduct extensive experiments to show that the semantic based adversarial examples can not only fool different learning tasks such as face verification and landmark detection, but also achieve high targeted attack success rate against \emph{real-world black-box} services such as Azure face verification service based on transferability.To further demonstrate the applicability of \emph{SemanticAdv} beyond face recognition domain, we also generate semantic perturbations on street-view images. Such adversarial examples with controlled semantic manipulation can shed light on further understanding about vulnerabilities of DNNs as well as potential defensive approaches.
summary_zh: 深度神经网络（DNN）凭借强大的表达能力在各类应用中取得了优异表现，但近期研究表明深度神经网络极易受到对抗样本的攻击：对抗样本是经过人为篡改的输入实例，目的是误导深度神经网络输出错误预测。目前绝大多数对抗样本通过限制扰动的Lp范数来保证“扰动微小”的特性，本文从图像语义属性篡改的角度出发，探索语义篡改对深度神经网络预测结果的影响，生成“无约束对抗样本”。具体而言，本文提出SemanticAdv算法，利用解耦的语义因子，通过修改可控语义属性生成对抗扰动，诱导学习器输出各类对抗目标结果。大量实验结果表明，基于语义的对抗样本不仅可以误导人脸验证、地标检测等不同学习任务，还可依托迁移性，针对Azure人脸验证服务等真实世界黑盒服务实现极高的定向攻击成功率。为进一步验证SemanticAdv算法在人脸识别领域之外的适用性，本文还在街景图像上生成了语义对抗扰动。这类具备可控语义篡改特性的对抗样本可为深度神经网络漏洞的后续研究以及防御方案设计提供新思路。

title: FreqSpaNet: Frequency and Spatial Learning of SFPF for Physical Layer Hardware Integrity Detection
title_zh: FreqSpaNet：面向物理层硬件完整性检测的SFPF频域空间学习网络
authors: Xiaoxuan Huang, Jinlong Xu, YiZhe Wang, Meng Zhang, Xian Li 等 (6 人)
abstract: Unauthorized hardware replacement can preserve a wireless device's logical identity while altering its physical implementation, posing a challenge to hardware integrity verification. Spatio-frequency polarization fingerprints (SFPFs) capture device-dependent responses across multiple frequencies and directions, but their frequency and spatial dimensions exhibit different structural dependencies. We propose FreqSpaNet, an SFPF representation learning network for open set hardware anomaly detection. A frequency branch captures local variations among neighboring frequencies, while a geometry-aware spatial branch models directional relationships using angular information. The two representations are combined through adaptive fusion, and complementary pretraining further captures shared information while preserving the distinct characteristics of the frequency and spatial representations.
